noi_dung:
1. The Relics of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Buddha Shakyamuni once said to Universal Bodhisattva: “You should know that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva can be said to be a Bodhisattva with hundreds of thousands of millions of great mighty powers and beneficial deeds. The sentient beings in the Jambudvipa world have many causes and conditions for this Great Being. These sentient beings hear the Bodhisattva's name, see the Bodhisattva's statue, even hear a few words in the Sutra or a verse of the Sutra, all of them will receive supreme blessings, peace and happiness in their lives. In the future, hundreds of thousands of lives later, they will all be reborn in a place of wealth and honor." Buddha once said to Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva: "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva in Jambudvipa also has many causes and conditions. If we talk about seeing and hearing the benefits of sentient beings, it cannot be exhausted in hundreds of thousands of lifetimes. "So we get to see Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva with people in this world. There is indeed a great cause and effect, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's career of saving sentient beings is no less than that of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. Buddha Shakyamuni in Dao Loi heavenly palace praised and rewarded the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Make Avalokitesvara announce it to everyone. Therefore, we know that the two Bodhisattvas have a very deep relationship with sentient beings in this land. Most people in the world know about Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva's saving lives, but very few people understand about Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's teachings, and few people talk about Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's saving sentient beings in hell. That was such a mistake. If we finish reading this book, we will understand that: Sentient beings who want to pray for Bodhisattvas' blessings can do so right away, without having to wait until the next life. Not to mention in the Sutras it says: "Bodhisattvas are afraid of causes, sentient beings are afraid of results." Saving results is of course necessary, but saving causes is even more urgent. People who commit ten evil deeds in this world will die in the next life and go to hell, that is the result. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva still helps those who have gone to hell, let alone those who have not yet gone to hell, why would he not think about it?

If this Great Bodhisattva teaches in any other place, we cannot see it with our physical eyes, so we do not understand, but in China, there are thousands of accurate and cumulative transformations of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Right in Anhui province, Cuu Hoa Mountain, in China, there are four ashrams at four famous mountains. In Putuo Mountain in the South Sea, there is Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, Ngu Dai Mountain in Son Tay, there is Bodhisattva Manjushri's Ashram. Emei Mountain in Sichuan has the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra's Ashram. Nine Flowers Mountain in Anhui has the Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha's Dharma Place. Every July, there are countless pilgrims who come to worship Mount Hoa Son. Because July 30 is the day of Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha's enlightenment. On this occasion, I would like to recount Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha's vow to establish the Dharma Place. I hope we remember this carefully, we can call Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva or Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva both.

When the Buddha passed away 1,500 years ago, in the 4th year of the Tang Dynasty, in the East there was a country called Silla, which is the current Korean state (Korea). In the Northeast, there was a crown prince named Kim Kieu Giac. At the age of 24, he became a monk, brought a white dog, called Thien Thinh, across the sea to China, in Anhui province, Tri Chau prefecture, Thanh Duong district on Cuu Hoa mountain. Remaining forever on Cuu Tu mountain, sitting in meditation for 75 years, with Son Than offering food and drink, it was not until the reign of Duong Huyen Ton Khai Nguyen on the night of July 30, the 16th year that he attained enlightenment.

At that time, at the foot of Cuu Hoa Son mountain, there was an old man who often called him Man Cong. On weekdays, he did good deeds, often offering vegetarian food to 99 monks, but there was still one monk missing to complete the number 100. Now there is a Master on the mountain, Ksitigarbha Sangha, so he wanted to invite him down the mountain to complete the number 100. This has been expected for many years. In the middle of the night of enlightenment, Son Than led him down the mountain to meet Man Cong and asked Man Cong for a piece of land the size of a robe. Man Cong said: "The land of Cuu Hoa mountain is all mine. So Bodhisattva can choose as much as he wants." At that time, the Bodhisattva took off his robe and spread it out to cover the entire Cuu Hoa mountain. Man Gong was very happy when he saw that, so he offered the entire Cuu Hoa mountain to the Bodhisattva. He also told his son to become a monk, that is, Venerable Minh Dao. Later, Man Cong also became a monk. Because I later became a monk, I had to worship my son, Master. In the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva on the left, there is a young monk, Venerable Minh Dao, on the right, an old man, Man Gong. The white dog is Thien Thinh, 20 years after the Bodhisattva entered samadhi, in the second year of Chinh Duc year, on July 30, he became a saint and built a tower. From then on, Nine Flowers Mountain in Anhui province became the great Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha. If we talk about the Bodhisattva saving sentient beings, as the Buddha said, hundreds of thousands of lifetimes cannot be counted. As the above paragraph said, the story of the country in the East is true. In books such as the Tale of the God of Monks, the Tale of the High Monk, the Tale of the Layman, the Nine Flowers Mountain, etc. All these things are recorded.

2. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Past Causes and Conditions

Why did Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's great vow to save sentient beings exist? Once we know the Bodhisattva's past lives and causes, we can understand clearly. Bodhisattva's past life was once the son of a wealthy man, once the daughter of a Brahmin, once a King, and once a Holy Maiden of Light. All are clearly recorded in the original prayer book Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra. Now let's talk about two things, one is the son of a rich man, the other is the daughter of a Brahmin.

First of all, we talk about the very ancient past, when a Buddha named Lion Phan Tan with full Van Hanh Tathagata was born. At that time Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva was still an ordinary person, the son of a wealthy man. He saw that the Buddha's appearance was very dignified and upright, his heart was very happy, so he went to worship Buddha Tathagata and asked: Why does Buddha have such a good appearance? Buddha replied: "If you want to cultivate and have such a good appearance, you need to make a great vow, you must forever transcend all suffering of living beings to be able to achieve it." The rich man's son immediately swore before the Buddha: "From now on, if there are sentient beings in the six paths who suffer, I must find a way to save them and become a Buddha, and then I will become a Buddha. If in this world there is still the six paths of reincarnation or the three evil paths, then I will still be a Bodhisattva to save sentient beings. Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, in front of the Lion Buddha, with full effort, Van Hanh made a vow until now, not knowing that he had already done so. It is impossible to say how many great kalpas he has passed through. He has transcended countless sentient beings, so he is still a Bodhisattva and has not yet become a Buddha.

I talk about the very ancient past, when a Buddha named Enlightenment Samadhi Free King Tathagata appeared in the world. At that time, there was a Brahman Saint who believed in Buddhism very much, but on the contrary, the Saint's Mother did not believe in Buddhism and even slandered the Three Jewels. Therefore, when you die, you must go to hell. The saint knew that her mother would suffer a lot after her death. Therefore, he sold all his assets to do many Buddhist works, repairing the Giac Hoa Dinh Tu Tu Tathagata pagoda and tower. One day, with sincere intention, I felt the Buddha's spirit. Suddenly I heard a voice echoing from above: "If you want to know how Mother appears, go home and recite Buddha's name and you will understand." The saint returned home, so she sat solemnly and single-mindedly recited the holy name of Lord Tathagata, who read for a day and a night, suddenly felt that she had come to a beach, the water in the sea was boiling, there were many people going in and out of there, being beaten and torn apart by demons and poisonous beasts, suffering all kinds of things, so miserable that I really didn't dare to look. The holy woman wholeheartedly recited Buddha's name, so she was not frightened at all. At that time, a Demon King came to greet him, and the Saint asked: "Where is this?". The Demon King replied: "This is the coast of hell". People in the world commit killing, stealing, adultery, lying, arguing, cursing, and committing many sins. If you die after 49 days and still have no one to pray for blessings and repent, you must go to this sea. In the East, there is a sea that is even more miserable than this sea. There is another sea in the East Sea that is even more miserable. Through three layers of karma to reach hell, it's even more miserable." The saint asked again: "Where is my mother now?", and told her name, date of birth and date of death. The ghost king finished examining and replied: "When your mother first arrived, she had to suffer in hell, but because of a son who was filial and sought blessings, three days ago she was born in Heaven." At that time, the Saint woke up as if from a dream. Knowing that she had been transcended, she made a great vow in front of the tower of Bodhisattva Bodhisattva Samadhi King Tathagata. Vows: "In the future, all sentient beings in the three evil paths are guilty, I vow to completely save them and let them become Buddhas before I can attain Bodhi. If the sinners' hell has not ended, I vow not to become a Buddha." Therefore Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is still a Bodhisattva to this day.

We have learned about Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha's past conditions. We should also understand that Bodhisattva in the past made a great vow to save all the suffering of sentient beings and live happily with them. All sentient beings must be saved and then become Buddhas. Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's incarnations fill the entire world. Each world incarnates into tens of thousands of millions, each body contains hundreds of thousands of millions of people, leading to the Three Jewels. Forever leaving the suffering of birth and death, arriving at a place of happiness. Therefore, every time we read the title of Bodhisattva, we often call it Namo Great Vow Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Because Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra records: Sakyamuni Buddha in Dao Loi Thien Palace rubbed Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's head, praising Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's immeasurable divine power. Compassion is beyond measure, wisdom is beyond measure, eloquence is also beyond measure, causing the Buddhas of ten thousand eons to praise them endlessly.

Buddha also thoughtfully told the heavenly beings who were in the burning house but had not yet escaped the three worlds. Advise Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, if there are heavenly people who have even a little good root in the Buddha Dharma, they should be blessed and educated to help them grow and not let them escape. If one falls into the evil realm, one can recite a good sentence or the name of a Bodhisattva, or one verse of a Sutra from the Mahayana Sutras. One must also use divine power to save and manifest all kinds of manifestations, so as not to fall into hell, and make Heavenly beings enjoy happiness and joy. We can see Tathagata's heart to help sentient beings just like Parents love their children. Understanding the suffering of his children, he tried every way to cure them. Even though he had to suffer, he did not complain. When he was about to die, he was afraid that his children would lose their support. He tried to find relatives or friends and solemnly entrusted them to them so that they could die without repentance. We read the Ksitigarbha Sutra, and when we get to the part that the Buddha entrusted, we realize that we sentient beings are very grateful to the Buddha. Until today, we have created bad karma, so we suffer the consequences of suffering. But Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva always helps us, always guides us, but unfortunately our eyes have not yet opened, we cannot see the Great Man's face, we cannot hear the Great Man's teachings, but the Great Man saves us from life and death. Living beings receive help without knowing it, just like light shines everywhere, but blind people do not enjoy that benefit because they cannot see. How painful! Buddha Shakyamuni is infinitely compassionate. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva was entrusted by the Buddha to demonstrate endless compassion. We just hope that everyone of us will quickly stop doing evil deeds, cultivate good deeds, respect the Three Jewels, and naturally be blessed by Buddha and Bodhisattvas.

3. Merits and Benefits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Even though Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has such great karma and karma with sentient beings in the world, if he has such great karma, then what merit and benefit will he gain by making offerings to Bodhisattva? In the chapters in Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows, the chapter on the Matching Karma of Sentient Beings, the Praise of the Tathagata, the chapter on the Dharma Protector of the Earth Spirit, the chapter on Knowledge and Benefits, and the chapter on Wishing the Fall of Heavenly Humans are all very clearly narrated. Now let us briefly recall.

If there is any sentient being who, upon hearing the name of the Bodhisattva, clasps his hands or praises, respects or admires him, then that person has transcended 30 lifetimes of sins. If any living being draws an image of a Bodhisattva, or casts or engraves an image of a Bodhisattva in gold, silver, bronze, or stone, and then admires and worships it once, then that person will be reborn a hundred times in heaven 33 and forever leave the evil path. If you are a woman who is tired of being a girl and devotedly worships the Bodhisattva image for the rest of your life, then in your next life you will escape being a girl. If any sentient being sings and praises in front of Bodhisattva or Buddha statues, plays music, sings songs, then uses incense and flowers to make offerings or urges one or more people to follow, then right now and in the future they will be blessed by good gods, and that person will forever be free from all hardships and unexpected disasters.

If there is a living being lying paralyzed on a hospital bed, wishing for life and death is impossible, and there are people who dream of demons entering the house at night, or go on dangerous roads and play with demons, then after a long time they become sick and lie miserable at night, sad and miserable. That is to argue according to the path of karma that has not yet been determined whether it is heavy or light, so the illness cannot be cured temporarily, or it is difficult to let go of one's life. That incident, to our mortal eyes, feels very difficult to understand. But if in front of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, we loudly recite the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, or take the patient's most precious belongings, such as clothes or jewels, and loudly say in front of the patient: "I am a patient in front of the sutras and statues. I do not regret all of these things, giving them all up to make offerings to print sutras, cast statues of Bodhisattvas and Buddhas, or build Stupas and Pagodas, or light lamps to worship and give alms to the permanent residence." Just read it three times in front of the patient so the patient can hear clearly. If at the time of death, from 1 to 7 days, the patient keeps chanting loudly as above and loudly chanting this Sutra, then after death, this person's crimes, no matter how serious, will be completely freed.

If any sentient being sees someone reading this Sutra (i.e. Earth Store Bodhisattva's Original Vows Sutra), wholeheartedly praising, and reverent, he will gain thousands of means. Advise them to be conscientious and not regress, this merit will be immeasurable. If any living being dreams of a ghost or spirit appearing, or crying, lamenting, or being afraid. This is all because in the past there were relatives who fell into evil paths and have not yet escaped. Don't expect to be saved by blessings. If you sincerely read this Sutra before the Buddha, or ask others to read it 3 or 7 times, you will be liberated thanks to that merit. From then on, I no longer saw ghosts or gods in my dreams. If there is a lowly person who is not free to repent of his past sins and recite the Bodhisattva's name thousands of times, he will often be honored. If a boy or girl born within 7 days recites this sutra and recites the Bodhisattva's name ten thousand times, then the child's sins in the previous life will be eradicated. Long-lasting happiness, increased blessings.

Nam Jambudvipa, sentient beings have unsightly gestures and thoughts, these are all karma and crimes. If during the 10 days of fasting, i.e. the first, eighth, fourteenth, full moon, eighteenth, twenty-third, twenty-fourth, twenty-eighth, twenty-nineth and thirtieth of each month, that is, the first, eighth, fourteenth, fifteenth, eighteenth, twenty-third, twenty-fourth, twenty-eighth, twenty-ninth, and thirtieth because the days mentioned above are the days of gathering sins, read this Sutra once in front of the Buddha statue, then all four parts of the land will be free from all disasters. Those who resided in this area for hundreds of thousands of years were forever free from crime. Having enough food and warm clothes, disasters go away, blessings come, the above sayings are all the words that Shakyamuni Buddha said to Universal Bodhisattva.

In the south there is a pure place. There is a temple built with materials such as soil, stone, bamboo, and wood. In the temple, there are many statues of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva carved in gold, stone, earth, and wood. Burning incense, worshiping, worshiping and praising, if anyone in that place has 10 benefits:

One is Fertile land.

Two are people, a peaceful home

Three is that the Dead are born in Heaven.

Fourth is Wealth and long life.

Years is All wishes come true.

Sixth is No disasters of water and fire.

Seventh is Avoid all evil spirits.

Eight is Absolute freedom from nightmares.

Nine is that when you enter or leave, you will be blessed by good spirits.

Ten are Common Saints.

Those were the words that Kien Lao Dia Than presented to Shakyamuni Buddha. If any sentient being hears the Bodhisattva's name with their ears when they are about to die, after death they will forever leave the three evil paths of suffering. If that person's relatives take valuable objects or money from the sick person, carve or paint an image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Or maybe when the illness is not yet at the point of death, one can hear and see this incident, then this person's heavy karma will be eliminated.

I have a friend named Hua Binh Khon, whose grandson is named Co Ton Tin. From the age of 2 until the age of 6, he suffered from lymphadenopathy, and the doctors were helpless. At that time, listening to Hua Binh Khon's advice, the family brought the child's precious things and sold them for some money. Then, in front of the child, he said three times, sell these things for 10 dong. Kun carved a statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and placed it in the middle of the hall downstairs. Every day, we respectfully worship. Not long after, the child's illness was cured. It's been 4 years now. All minor illnesses such as headaches and fever are gone. On March 2, the 16th year of the Republic of China (1927), I visited Hua Bingkun at Najin Street No. 283 in Shanghai. I learned that it was a matter of seeing and hearing. It is proven that the merits and benefits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva are truly immeasurable and there are many stories of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's inspiration, through the ages clearly stating the truth, recorded thoroughly in Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Inspiration (Please read carefully).

And the lifespan increases even more. If those people's karma has ended, because they committed a crime and deserved to go to hell, then all karma will be reduced, and they will soon be transcended and happy. If there are sentient beings who, when they were young, lost their parents and siblings, year after year they miss them and want to know what they are like now? If this person can stay for one to seven days, carve or draw an image of the Bodhisattva. Hearing the name, seeing the image, persevering in contemplation and worship, without losing the initial mind, then if this person's relatives fall into the evil realm, they will be liberated and reborn in the human world or the heavenly world and be happy. If you are a human being, you will be reincarnated as a Saint and enjoy infinite joy. If within 21 days, one wholeheartedly contemplates the image and recites the name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva ten thousand times, the Bodhisattva will appear, show where his relatives are, or in his dream lead him to meet his relatives. If you can recite Bodhisattva's name a thousand times a day, for a thousand days, Bodhisattva will command ghosts or Earth Gongs in that land to protect you. In this life, you will have all peace and happiness, and will also receive prophecies from the Bodhisattva rubbing your crown.

If there is a living being who wants to develop a compassionate heart to save sentient beings, wants to go beyond the three worlds, and cultivate unsurpassed Bodhi, if this person meets the Bodhisattva, hears the Bodhisattva's name, wholeheartedly takes refuge and worships, then certain wishes will be quickly fulfilled, including ordinary things, whatever one wishes for. If there is a living being who reads and recites the Mahayana Sutras but cannot easily comprehend them, if they hear the Bodhisattva's name, see the Bodhisattva's statue, respectfully offer incense and flowers, respectfully request all manner of worship, take a glass of clear water and place it in front of the Buddha statue, after one day and one night clasp their hands, look solemnly towards the South and drink, drink and abstain from alcohol, meat, adultery, killing, and lying for seven days or twenty-one days. In a dream, that person sees the Bodhisattva incarnate and is washed with water. When he wakes up, he will feel intelligent. When he hears the Sutras read through his ears, he will remember them forever and never forget.

If there are any sentient beings who are poorly dressed, have many illnesses, or have an insecure family life, or have nightmares of all kinds of suffering at night, then respect them. If you recite the Bodhisattva name ten thousand times, disasters will naturally go away and blessings will come. If any sentient being has to go into the forest or cross the sea, before going, they must chant the Bodhisattva's name ten thousand times, then they will be blessed by the demon god Earth Gong, and will be free from all dangers. The above mentioned events are all the words of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara.

If any living being sees the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, or hears the sound of chanting Sutras, or chants and worships, offers food, drink, clothes and precious things, sincerely worships and bows, they will receive 28 types of benefits:

It is the Heavenly Dragon's protection.

It is the increasingly good fruit. increase.

Meeting the Saints.

Is Bodhi that does not rot.

Is Adequate Food and Medicine.

Is Diseases do not come.

Is Staying away from water and fire ears.

Is There is no danger of thieves.

Is everyone who sees them loves them.

Is the Protector of the Devil.

Is Female transformed into male.

Is the King's Daughter Lord.

Is Doan Chinh, a good general.

Is the Most Born in Heaven.

Is Or Emperor.

Is Suc Tri, life and intelligence.

Is Right to the stage. spare.

Is Belonging to happiness.

Is Everything is destroyed.

Is Speak and go, everything is clear.

Is the Immortal of death and suffering.

Is Contains blessings for a lifetime.

Is praised by the Saints.

Is Intelligent and benefits the roots.

Is Compassionate introspection.

Becoming a Buddha at last.

If any living being prostrates, admires, worships the Bodhisattva image or praises the deeds of the Earth Store Vows, they will receive 7 benefits as follows:

Is Hurry to the Holy Land.

Is Evil Karma destroyed.

The Buddhas bless.

Is undiminished Bodhi.

Is Growth of the original force.

It is life-satisfactory.

Is Finally Becoming Buddha.

These are all said by Shakyamuni Buddha to Void Store Bodhisattva. There is also a very important thing, that is, in the chapter Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vow to Recite the Name, it is clearly stated that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva did not wait for the Buddha to ask, but solemnly told the Buddha himself: If there are sentient beings who recite the Buddha's name, they can reduce countless sins and receive countless blessings. Then the Buddhas of the past are such as Boundless Body Buddha, Lion's Roar Buddha, Ca Sa Trang Buddha, Precious Nature Buddha, Precious Form Buddha, Precious Thang Buddha, Pure Moon Buddha, Full Moon Buddha, Moon Face Buddha. If you hear the names of the Buddhas in your fingernails and then make up your mind to take refuge, you will stay on the highest path and never turn back.

If that person dies, the substitute family member loudly recites Buddha's name, and the deceased person is absolved of all serious sins, let alone reciting Buddha's name themselves. We see that Buddhas and Bodhisattvas love sentient beings more than parents love their children. Anyone who remembers and thinks will be saved. There is also Amitabha Buddha, very compassionate. This Buddha's world is called the Western Pure Land, just by reciting the phrase Namo Amitabha Buddha in our life we ​​will receive 10 types of merit and benefits. When he was about to die, Buddha came to guide him. From there, escape the sufferings of samsara. As if there were a person who single-mindedly recited the holy name, he would be able to eliminate 80 million mortal sins of birth and death. We should know that reciting Amitabha Buddha brings great merit:

This is because Amitabha Buddha once made a great vow to lead sentient beings to the West, the world of Ultimate Bliss. Therefore, we have a very great relationship with the Pure Land world.

This is because Amitabha Buddha is the body of the dharma realm, possessing the merits of the Buddhas in the ten directions. Amitabha Buddha is a Buddha who has everything, just like a treasure net, a thousand pearls strung into one string, one bead strung into a thousand pearls, neither too much nor too little. Therefore, the merit of reciting Amitabha Buddha's name is very great. We should know that, the merits and other benefits, all the things related to blessings in the future, even if we enjoy it for a whole day, if we only recite Amitabha Buddha, not only will we immediately enjoy the blessings in this life, but after reaching the Western Pure Land, we will forever remain unchanged, forever transcending the six paths of reincarnation, completely separated from birth and death. We often chant the name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and single-mindedly chant Namo Amitabha Buddha, later we will enjoy truly endless joy.

4. Response to the Indications of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva often teaches and transforms sentient beings according to their base. Thousands of thousands of careful instructions, we must clearly understand the truth of cause and effect, to avoid suffering. Because if we plant many good roots, we will reap good results, but if we plant evil roots, we will definitely get evil results. Just like when you plant pumpkins you get pumpkins, when you plant beans you get beans, deciding that the law of cause and effect is not wrong, so the Bodhisattva met a murderer and said that he would receive a short-lived retribution, thieves and robbers would receive miserable retributions, adulterers would fall as pigeons, and lovebirds would be punished. Those who are cruel and slander people will have painful retribution on their tongues, those who are angry will meet with ugly retribution, and those who are stingy will meet with the retribution of nothing. Those who are not filial to their parents will face retribution in heaven. Defaming the Three Jewels will result in deaf and mute retribution. Those who hunt and kill will meet the retribution of having to be reincarnated far away. Those who are arrogant and proud will meet vile retributions like those who meet sinners. Bodhisattva will tell them the retribution of all sins, if those sinners, without knowing how to repent, after receiving retribution, when they die, they will have to go to hell and suffer all kinds of suffering. Most people only know what wins and loses in the short term, do not understand the law of cause and effect, do illegal things and no longer know what the law of cause and effect is. I really don't know what tomorrow's suffering will be like? What a pitiful and unfortunate thing.

You should know that the law of retribution is divided into 3 types: The first type is present retribution, that is, doing good or bad things in this life, good or bad things also come in this life. The second type is retribution in this life, doing good or evil deeds, so that in the next life you will encounter blessings or misfortunes. The third type is post-retribution, in this life we ​​do good or evil deeds, we have to wait until the 3rd or 4th life, or thousands of eons or countless eons, to know the good or bad things. In short, for those who create negative karma, there is no reason why there is no retribution. In this life, people who encounter disasters, if they don't resent heaven, then blame others, and refuse to think about repaying their debts from previous lives and regret it. This type of person only sees good and evil in front of their eyes. Sometimes when they randomly do a good deed and encounter disaster, they think they should not do the good deed. Sometimes when we do evil things, we think that doing evil things is not something to worry about. Because they do not understand the law of retribution for good and evil deeds, which is not something that happens overnight but is something that has been accumulated over many lifetimes. For example, snow and ice that are 3 meters thick in winter are not formed by just one cold day. They only know how to calculate the immediate benefits. That's why people are greedy and do things that harm others, are selfish, and most people in this world don't have compassion. So why should the world not come to this level again?

In the past 10 years, there has been a fierce battle in the Western Ocean, killing thousands of people and hundreds of millions of people starving to death. Even in China's provinces, natural disasters have killed more than millions of people. An earthquake in Japan killed many thousands of people. Let's think that in just about 10 years, it has been so disastrous. People's hearts in the past were much better than those of today, because most people believed in the principle of cause and effect. Therefore, for more than a hundred years and ten years of peace in the world, it is really nothing significant. People only know that today's people's hearts are corrupt compared to ancient people's. The current world is not as good as in the past. We can know that this is the principle of cause and effect. That is a very transparent truth. Such a world, such a family or a person. From ancient times to the present, there is no shortage of real evidence appearing. Still don't believe it? Let's look at the people in this world, some are poor, some are rich, some are miserable and some are happy. There are strong people and weak people: There are beautiful people and there are ugly people. There are wise people and there are foolish people, they are not all the same. There must be a reason there. That reason is cause and effect. There is always death in human life, but death is not the end, there is always an afterlife. That is, if there is an afterlife, then there will definitely be reincarnation. If there is reincarnation, then there will also be the morality of cause and effect, mastering it.

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is extremely compassionate and only wants everyone in this world to leave suffering and be happy, so he finds every way to encourage people to understand the principle of cause and effect. Since that is the case, we take this opportunity to urgently call on everyone to clearly understand the principle of cause and effect, to know that among all sins, killing is the heaviest. We all need to be vegetarian and recite Buddha's name. If we cannot be vegetarian at the moment, it is better not to kill lives.

According to Layman Ly Vien Tinh

5. You should copy and recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra

The Ksitigarbha Sutra was recommended and recited by Venerable Hsuan Hua, a contemporary holy monk. Ksitigarbha Sutra has no more than 8 words: Filial piety, saving life, overcoming suffering, repaying kindness.

- What is filial piety: This sutra promotes filial piety, which is the foundation of humanity

- Saving sentient beings is the original vow of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. We practice first to save ourselves and then to save people and animals.

- The end of suffering is when we recite it, all suffering will be eliminated

- To repay gratitude means we recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra to repay the four kindnesses: gratitude to our parents, gratitude to our teachers, gratitude to Buddha, gratitude to sentient beings.

How should one recite?

Depending on our work, the time we spend chanting. If possible, you can spend some time early in the morning or late at night to recite. Should be maintained regularly for a set period of time (made a vow) or daily is better. Please maintain regular sessions, preferably male sessions, female sessions. Very beneficial why? Because you have spent time reviewing the Buddha's teachings, thereby applying them to your spiritual life, the time you spend chanting is a useful time, focusing your mind rather than letting your mind wander around.

Where to read? How to read?

You can read and chant sutras anywhere, except for places that are not solemn and clean such as bathrooms, places where couples live, etc. Depending on the conditions, you can read aloud, or read silently, read with your eyes, etc. If there is a solemn Buddha table, even better, some busy people can read at work during breaks, etc., that's okay.

It should be read slowly and clearly to help us understand easily, and the invisible and visible sentient beings around us can also understand and penetrate the sutras to become enlightened.

When should you chant Ksitigarbha Sutra?

If we can chant every day, that's great, but if we can't, we can chant once a week or once a month. Especially when we have things that need to be chanted wholeheartedly such as: There is a death in the family, preparing for pregnancy, during pregnancy and giving birth. In addition, when life is crazy and we are under pressure at work, if we have any wishes we want, we should dedicate ourselves to chanting Ksitigarbha Sutra for 7 days, 21 days, 49 days without interruption, then any wishes (charity) will be fulfilled. Whether everything is spiritual or not depends on whether you have sincerity or skepticism.

What should you pay attention to when chanting Ksitigarbha Sutra?

If you have made up your mind to be a vegetarian and abstain from the Five Precepts including: onions (including baro), chives, garlic, palanquin, hung cu (a plant with a garlic-like smell), and strictly keep the precepts (for lay people, you first need to keep the five precepts), then when reciting the sutra, you need to brush your teeth, rinse your mouth clean, take a shower, change into clean clothes and then recite.

For those of you who cannot be vegetarian, you should still strictly observe the Five Precepts, you should abstain from the Five Spices, and after eating salty foods for at least 2 hours, you should brush your teeth, rinse your mouth, take a shower and change into clean clothes before starting to chant the Sutras, otherwise you will commit a crime of disrespect! You should pay attention to this!

noi_dung:
1. Drawing Statues Out of Danger

Luong Dynasty in Hanzhou, Duong District, Thien Tich Pagoda. On the wall in the eastern corridor of the Pagoda, there is a painting by Truong Tang Dao of a statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, shaped like a monk, wearing a robe and sitting seriously, often with unusual light. Lan Duc was born in the Tang Dynasty, and there was a monk in the pagoda who painted it in the style of a statue that also had light radiating from it. Lan Duc, in his third year, when Vuong Ky took up his position at Tu Chau, often practiced drawing that statue and worshiped it very sincerely. At that time, a group of 10 boats were traveling together. A storm arose on the way. Nine boats were sunk, but only Vuong Ky's boat was unharmed. Obviously, he is blessed by the Bodhisattva of Compassion. Vuong Ky respectfully worshiped. Also in the third year, Lady Thien Hau learned about this, so she ordered the artist to follow and paint that statue, and the same light radiated as before.

In the year of Dai Lich, a Venerable at Bao Tho Pagoda saw that the painting in the ashram also radiated light, so he wrote a note to the King. The king also sincerely bowed and praised him immensely. The statue often radiates light and the country is peaceful.

There was a businessman whose wife was 28 months pregnant but had not yet given birth. One day, when he saw the light shining from a painting depicting Ksitigarbha, he determined to reverently imitate the painting of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. That night, he gave birth to a son, handsome and handsome, and everyone who saw him loved him. That is thanks to the wonderful light of the Bodhisattva.

2. Listen to the name and avoid imprisonment

During the Tang Dynasty in Ung Chau, Van district, there was a woman who often ate vegetarian food and worshiped Buddha, and had grave filial transgression. In the house, there is a wooden statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, one meter six high, very spiritual. Ly Thi had a maid, over 50 years old, who often had wrong views and did not believe in the Dharma. One day, waiting for Ly Thi to be absent from home, she took the statue and left it desolate in the yard outside the house. When Ly Thi returned, she cried and searched. Suddenly, he saw a light shining in the deserted area in front of his house. He happily went out to pick up the statue, but did not know that the Bhikkhu had done it. The next day, the Bhikkhu fainted, lost consciousness, then suddenly woke up, cried and regretted, and told herself what she had done: "When I died, I saw two mandarins riding horses, reading the official message, I committed a great sin because I destroyed and dishonored the Holy Statue." Now I have to be tied up to wait for the King's reprimand and punishment to be sent to hell. At that time, a teacher walked in. The king invited him to sit down and then respectfully asked the reason. He replied: "This person is the Servant of my sect. Even though I humiliated my statue, I cannot bear to punish her. I hope the King will show grace and grant her longevity." The king said: "I will do as you wish." At that time, I regretted it immensely, so I prayed: "Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva". Immediately, the sinners in the hall also chanted in unison, locking their arms and opening them on their own. He took my hand out of the hall. I then woke up.

After Ly Thi heard this, she respected the statue even more. Since then, people in the district have become more religious than before.

3. Help Father Sanh Thien

During the Tang Dynasty in Chau Phu, there was a Grandmother of the Presiding Officer's wife who revered Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, her faith was very sincere, only her biological parents who had not yet been born had faith. For her parents' sake, Grandma spent money to carve a golden statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, three meters high, and sincerely worshiped him. At that time, her father had to go away because of work, and her mother was home alone. That night, a thief tried to steal clothes. Looking through the door, he saw Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva sitting solemnly. The next day, the thief disguised himself and went to the house to investigate. He saw To Thi's mother alone and did not see any Saint Statue, so he was surprised and confessed his crime. Feeling ashamed, he recounted what happened the night before.

After her father went to Phu Chau, along the way he was surrounded and killed by enemies. Suddenly, a yellow-shirted monk used his hand to block the knife, used his head to receive the spear, and was injured lying on the ground. At that time, the enemy thought he was dead and withdrew, so her Father was spared harm. He was surprised, went home and told his son about it. He had a rare feeling and went to the Buddha Hall to worship. He saw that the statue's head had a few knife marks, the yellow color faded a little, and it seemed to be bleeding. Grandmother immediately knew that it was Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha who had endured three knife blows to save her Father. Her father immediately had faith and welcomed Mother to his house, serving day and night. The three people worshiped and made offerings day and night. Her father lived until he was seventy-nine years old before passing away. Thirty-five days later, her grandmother dreamed that her father appeared, her bright body standing in the air, floating naturally, giving birth to a rare thought. She knelt down and asked, "Where do you live now?". Answered: "Living in the fourth heaven with colleagues is all about nourishing the land. Most heavenly people rely on Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for guidance. The mother lives for thirty-five years, and the child lives for twenty-five years. Her husband lives for twenty-eight years." Having finished speaking, he disappeared. From then on, everything came true for Mother and her husband as Father had said. Since then, villagers all over Europe have been busy carving or painting images of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to worship. Everyone enjoys the Bodhisattva's protection.

4. Reciting Ksitigarbha's Name to Prevent Demons

During the Tang Dynasty, there was a layman Ly Tin Tu, from Lu Thuy, whose entire family of more than 30 people was harassed by demons. One by one, they got sick, some vomited blood, some fainted. At that time, Tin Tu was very upset and asked the monks for a rescue method. The teacher thought for a long time and said:

When the Buddha was still alive at the foot of Pi Phu La mountain, in the wealthy Kieu De family, he was also harassed by evil spirits, in a family of about 500 people. At that time, everyone was sick and did not wake up for 10 days. At that time, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva wandered to the rich man's house. At that time, he had compassion and recited the mantra to save and eliminate demons. Everyone will be at peace, you should follow that method, take refuge in Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha, and single-mindedly confess the name. Think, believe and follow, draw a picture of Bodhisattva. Since then, for 50 years, Lu Thuy district has not been bothered by ghosts anymore.

5. Worship the Resurrection Dharma

During the Tang Dynasty, in Trung Son Mountain, in Khai Thien Pagoda, there was a statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva three meters high, with a halo of four and a half meters. For many years, it was unknown who carved this statue. Later, there was Mr. Dang Tong, Admiral Duong Chau. At the age of 61, he fell ill and died, his chest was still warm and he could barely breathe, so his relatives did not dare to enter the shroud. At night he suddenly woke up, cried day and night, so he asked his family to guide him to Khai Thien Tu, and asked a monk: "In the temple there is a statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, three meters high, four and a half meters of halo, where is it? I want to come to worship and worship." The monks listened to the search, and after finding it, Dang Tong respected it and offered to take the statue back to worship. The monk asked: "Why?". Dang Tong replied: "When I died, I saw a fourth-rank mandarin. I was brought before a King and the King, saying: "You cannot die, serving the Dharma is your inheritance, you must live and return to the human world. The road to hell is very scary, you cannot know, do you want to see hell?" “I said yes.” The King then called an official dressed in green. He followed the King outside the city, going northeast for about five or six miles. There was an iron citadel with the door closed. Gradually, the intense firelight was seen. In prison, hundreds of thousands of criminals are suffering.

At that time, a monk entered the prison, subdued the fire, and taught the sinners. The fire gradually extinguished. Going to another iron city, in which there are eighteen levels of hell, the suffering of the sinners cannot be fully described, and saw the monk again teaching the sinners as before. After returning from the tour, that monk came out of hell and asked: "Do you know who I am?". I answered that I don't know. That monk said: "I am Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva here at Khai Thien Monastery. In the past, there was a master named Tri Tang Dharma Master, whose disciple was Dharma Master Tri Manh. In order to save the suffering of the three sentient beings, he carved my image. I obeyed, so every day for one hour I entered the eighteen levels of hell and countless small hells to teach and teach the Way. Those who had previously planted good roots and had stronger good powers immediately released their minds from suffering. In addition, those who had cut off good roots and had deep-rooted evil poisons were invincible. If you are unconscious, it is difficult to escape suffering. In this world, those with good roots are weak and can easily be saved. If once they enter the evil path, the Holy Power cannot save them, the evil will remain the same, because these unconscious karmas, if they later repent, will soon be able to escape the suffering of hell through the power of magic. Let everyone know, then admire that monk, three meters tall, with a bright light on his head. That monk taught two verses: "If you practice the Way in the human world, if you have the mind, you can develop it. If you enter into evil karma, it will be deep. Without discrimination in the mind, there can be no salvation. Like an old person who wants to walk, if he uses strength to help him, he can easily move forward. If you lie still and don't move, you won't have enough strength, then the karma of all sentient beings will be the same." The monk finished reading the two verses and then disappeared.

I was lying on my hospital bed remembering this incident, afraid that something was wrong so I didn't dare tell anyone. Now I can see that the statue is exactly the same as what I saw with my own eyes. For that reason, I want to bring it home to worship it. The monk in the pagoda was very happy when he heard that, praised and said: "You can imitate and sculpt this statue, but you can't carry it away." And this statue is still left in Khai Thien Tu.

6. Changing House into Pagoda

During the Tang Dynasty in Gian Chau, Kim Thuy district, there was a man named Thi Lang, surnamed Dang, who has always believed in Buddhism. One day, he saw a stick with a statue of a Master carved on its head, so he took it home and stuck it on the wall. Two or three years later, he suddenly fell ill and died, but his chest was still warm, so his family suspected him but did not bury him. The next night, he woke up, crying with tears streaming down his face and said: "When I first died, two people on horseback led me into the gate of a large city. In front of the hall, I saw a large number of people chained. The King was angry and wanted to question me. At that time, a Samana, with an ugly appearance, entered the hall. The King quickly stood up respectfully, clasped his hands and knelt down, saying: "Great Saint, why have you come here?" Sa Mon said: "This Thi Lang is my servant, the King should forgive her." The king said: "Now the decision has been made, the fate is over, the real fortune is gone, it is difficult to forgive." Samana said: "Before, when I was on the Good Dharma Hall in the 33rd heaven, the Buddha told me to save the karma of sinners. Since all this time, what's more, Thi Lang hasn't committed a serious crime, so why can't he be saved? The King said: "The Great Man's Great Vow is as firm and immovable as the Diamond Mountain. I followed the instructions and let him return to the human world."

Sa Mon was very happy to take my hand and lead me down the path of life. When I was about to leave, I asked: "The teacher who saved me is my great benefactor. Please give me the Dharma name to show my gratitude?" The monk replied: "I am Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Once along the way, Thi Lang picked up a stick with my image engraved on it. Although she didn't know it yet, she brought it back and put it on the wall. For the children's joy, she carved the image on the tip of the stick. Only halfway through carving the tip of the stick, it wasn't finished yet, so the image was ugly, do you remember, Thi Lang?" Having finished speaking, he disappeared.

Thi Lang woke up and saw that only the tip of the stick stuck on the wall remained, so she hired a worker to carve it five inches larger from sandalwood. The statue often radiates light throughout the room. Thi Lang carved another larger statue, left her house and built a pagoda called Ksitigarbha to worship small statues inside for good men and women from near and far to admire.

7. Thanks to Ksitigarbha to Escape from Tiger Tornage

During the Tang Dynasty, in Hoa Chau, Hui Nhut Tu had a teacher named Phap Thuong. At the age of thirty-seven, he became a monk. When I was at home, I often went hunting. One day, I saw a light shining from a bush and was surprised, so I got off my horse and went to look, only to see a piece of rotten wood more than a meter long, so I took it home. Later, when he went hunting again, he saw that the tree was shining again and was surprised, so he picked up the log to put it on the branch. On the way back, he met a Tiger, so he rode his horse to chase him. The bowstring is broken, there is no bowstring. The Tiger returned in panic and ran away, then fell off his horse in fear. I thought to myself that I would be pounced by a Tiger, it certainly couldn't be avoided. While confused, he saw an ugly looking Master come to chase away the Tiger. I asked who are you? He said: "I am Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. The rotten piece of wood in that bush is my body. Previously, your Patriarch Sangha used this tree to build a pagoda and create an image. Now the pagoda has been damaged, and my statue has also rotted.

Only the heart of the tree remains. You saw my light and came to save me.”

After waking up, I only heard the sound of horses neighing and could no longer see the Tiger's shadow. I felt extremely regretful so I went to the place where the light was shining and built a Vihara, a rotten piece of wood carved a statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and continued to worship with incense and lanterns, that is, Tue Nhat Tu. On February 24, Phap Thuong, who was 78 years old, told his friends: "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva came to my house and said: "He was in Tu Thi Tathagata's Dharma assembly three times. During the second Dharma teaching, he was the one who attained enlightenment. Today, when he gave up his life, he was immediately born in Dao Loi." I told the Great Master: "In heaven there is a realm of five desires, very happy. If Bodhi is lost, it will be difficult to meet the Buddha. Now I vow to be reborn in the West in a world of Peace and Happiness." Bodhisattva replied: "Depending on the person's wish, if one wants to be reborn in the Pure Land, one must recite Amitabha Buddha's name for one day and one night, and concentrate on maintaining the will to be reborn." Having reached Bodhisattva, since yesterday I have been focusing on reciting Amitabha Buddha. Now reborn, he spoke and clasped his hands towards the West and passed away.

8. Big epidemic, don't worry

During the Tang Dynasty, in Lo Chau, there was royal historian Khang Cu Thong, a most faithful person, who had worshiped Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha for many years, and was very sincere in painting images of Bodhisattva. Always respectful. No images have been missed, the light is bright and clear. It's all because of this faith. Accidentally, two soldiers on horseback came and chased him, he was very scared. The two military officers suddenly got off their horses and said: "We were wrong! Ksitigarbha Tan Viet. Even though he was at fault, it is difficult to blame him," and after saying that, he disappeared. When I woke up, I was even more sincere.

During the reign of Hy Tong Quang Nguyen, there was an epidemic in the country, demons were rampant, the dead piled up into mountains, and dreamed of hundreds of thousands of ghosts passing through the door of the house saying: "This house is the seventh room of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, we are servants, be careful not to enter this house." So the whole family was saved. In the year of Trung Hoa, he had to go far, so he lost his way in the snow and quickly prayed to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Suddenly there was a bird flying down the snowbank. Seeing it strangely, I chased after it until I reached the main road. When he arrived at Quang Khai, he was sick and prayed sincerely to be cured. Dreamed that the Master said: "You killed my blue bird, a crime worthy of going to hell. Now you have to pay for that karma, suffer for two days before being born in the Pure Land." After hearing this, he happily worshiped, his illness immediately cured, and after two days he passed away.

9. Praying for Golden Blessings

During the Song Dynasty, in Tran Luu district, there was a poor young lady who worked for others to make a living, and her life was hard. She then fasted, recited the holy name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and prayed for his blessings and wealth. Self-assessment of my past karma is very heavy, I don't know if I can achieve my wish?

On the 24th day of the second lunar month, the 5th year of Khai Bao, she saw ants crawling all over the house, and did not dare to enter the house for fear of stepping on the ants to death. Then she saw the ants gradually turning yellow. She was scared. The neighbors saw that and were also surprised. After a day and a night, she entered the house and saw the ants disappear and saw that the carpet was full of gold, just three ounces. The young girl sold it and became rich. After that, my heart became more and more confident in the Bodhisattva, so I took that house and built it into a pagoda to worship and worship him. Later, there was a widowed District Lord who married that young woman and pampered him in every way.

10. Radiation Eliminates Diseases

During the Song Dynasty, the villages in Liaocheng had more than two thousand households. They had always worshiped the Dharma and believed strongly in Avalokitesvara and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, especially the Avalokitesvara Sutra and the Ten Wheel Sutra. There is an ancient pagoda with three compartments and four wings, a green roof with a red carpet, on the left and right sides are placed two statues of Guan Yin and Ksitigarbha, seven and a half meters high, in the middle is a solemn statue of Amitabha Buddha, one meter and six meters high.

During the reign of King Thai Tong, the country was peaceful and prosperous. Suddenly an epidemic spread, many people died. The City Lord prayed before the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and saw a light emitting light throughout the village. Wherever the light shines, everyone will be cured. Those who have died will be resurrected. There was a Goddess who did not believe in Buddhism and died of illness. One night later, he came back to life, stayed in the monastery, prayed to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, cried and asked to become a monk. Someone asked why? The Goddess replied: "I was captured and tied by a demon. I called God to save me. I was also afraid of evil spirits. After being influenced by the Teacher, the demon left me. The Teacher said: "You are a foolish Goddess, relying on Shinto, not believing in Buddhism. I am the Bodhisattva Maha Ksitigarbha. According to the request of the Holy Master, save the lives of ignorant people, build temples in villages, protect evil spirits, I control demons, why? Demons create their own karma." The Goddess narrated the words of the Teacher, and said to herself: "Now I see this incident and am resurrected. From now on, I have reformed my ways, so I want to become a monk." Everyone happily let the Goddess become a Nun.

11. Praying for Teething

During the Song Dynasty, in Thien Phuc Pagoda, in the northeast corner, there was a statue of Ksitigarbha, one meter six meters high, it is unknown who carved it and when. All I know is that many people say that the statue is very magical, and those who come to sleep or pray for something are very successful. At that time, a layperson, about thirty-seven years old, but without any teeth, came to the statue, not eating and praying gently all over his body. In the middle of the night, I dreamed that the statue came to touch its head, and soon it grew 38 teeth. Everyone heard and saw such a strange thing, so they imitated the drawing of Ksitigarbha's image and set up an altar to worship, and they were all inspired. Many people know this story.

noi_dung:
12. Bodhisattva Incarnation

During the Song Dynasty, there was a monk named Tri Huu, a native of West India, who came to China in the year Thien Phuc, and lived at Thanh Thai Temple. In the sutra, there is an image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and in the Sutra of the Vow of Merits, in Sanskrit, in the middle circle there is a statue and image of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara, wearing a crown and holding a treasure in his hand. On the right and left sides there are 10 Saint images. The five on the left are: Qin Quang Vuong, So Giang Vuong, Song De Vuong, Ngu Quan Vuong and Diem La Vuong. On the right, there are five people: 1. Kha Thanh Vuong, 2. Thai Son Vuong, 3. Equal Equality King, 4. Do Thi Vuong, and Five Paths Chakravartin King. 14. The Divine Medicine of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

tom_tat: When you are sick and cannot be cured by Eastern and Western medicine, you only have to sit and endure the pain or wait for death, then why don't you try the last method, which is to find BUDDHA Dharma. There are many people who have recovered from their illnesses thanks to…

Thien Nhu

When you are sick and cannot be cured by Eastern and Western medicine, you only have to sit and endure the pain or wait for death, then why don't you try the last method, which is to find BUDDHA Dharma. There are many cases of people cured thanks to this method, and I am a proof. Around the beginning of 2017, I (Thien Nhu) started working as a chef for a Korean restaurant specializing in seafood and grilled dishes in Vung Tau City. Perhaps because my work involves a lot of shrimp, crab, fish, squid, beef, pork, etc., my hands gradually began to ulcerate, then bleed, peeling off the skin on my hands, causing extreme pain and discomfort.

I went to the hospital and the doctor concluded that I had "DRY MELAMIC" disease, I just needed to apply and take medicine for a while and I would be fine. But it's so strange! Even though I drank enough and applied all kinds of medicine, this disease still did not improve at all. Every night I couldn't sleep because my hands were itchy more than usual. So I tried my best to scratch until the itch was gone, I kept scratching the other hand with one hand but it didn't go away, and I kept rubbing my hands together constantly... to the point that the cracks on my palms and fingertips bled but the itching still didn't go away.

I never had a good night's sleep, the above situation kept repeating and I could only lie down and cry... I stopped taking all the medicine and topical medicine from the hospital because I was so depressed (taking it forever, applying it over and over with no sign of improvement)

Someone showed me how to cut a lemon, then rub it on the itchy area (because lemon has acid that will kill disease-causing bacteria and fungi. That person did that and it was cured). I did the same many times but to no avail, and to be honest with everyone, the feeling of rubbing a piece of lemon on my itchy, cracked, bleeding hand really made me want to die...

I immediately thought of the living beings I killed, chopped into pieces, and then marinated them with spices... They must have been as painful as the feeling I am feeling now (I know I am suffering retribution). At this moment I deeply regret the work I did.

After a period of fruitless treatment, I hugged my hands and cried every night, enduring pain and despair...And then the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas blessed me. Luckily, I was guided by the Admin of nhanqua.com.vn on how to repent for the injustice of the bondholders and recite Buddha's name, especially chanting the Dharma Destroying Karma Dharani mantra: "HUG PRA MA NI DANI XOA HA" Then dedicate all the merits. merit to the unjust bondholders who caused the disease in my hands (the animals that I harmed). I practiced tirelessly with deep faith. A few weeks after I started chanting the Destroying Karma mantra, suddenly my hands showed signs of healing: the cracks began to close, blood stopped leaking, the skin on my hands stopped peeling, and new skin began to form...

I was overjoyed, and continued to repent and recite Buddha's name even while working, walking, even when cooking, I recited Buddha's name... just like that, my DRY MELAMICAL disease has completely cured until now!!! After this incident, I resigned from my job even though at that time life was very difficult. If I quit while waiting for a new job, all family expenses would be affected... But not long after, I found another job, less difficult, with a stable salary, especially very beneficial for everyone.

I thought: “Perhaps Buddha - Bodhisattva protected me, because during my illness I realized my sins, sincerely repented, believed absolutely without any doubt in the Buddha Dharma, chanted mantras, recited the Buddha's name without stopping and then dedicated it to the wronged family to atone for my sins... Furthermore, I definitely stopped that job of killing even though I knew there would be many difficulties to come.”

If anyone falls into the same situation as me, when medicine is no longer effective. Try to do like me, you will see the extraordinary effectiveness of BUDDHA, and the mantra of King Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva: "EMGRA MANI DANI XOA HA"

15. Copying Ksitigarbha Sutra From Tumor

I am not a Buddhist, nor do I know much about Buddhism. But fortunately, thanks to a person who sowed fate, I encountered a miracle. For long-time Buddhists, perhaps it is obvious, but for me, it is a very miraculous thing.

My name is Nguyen Chien (born in 1998) and live in Van Ninh, Mong Cai City, Quang Ninh.

Since I was born, I have had a small blister growing on my collarbone. As I grew older, it gradually grew larger into a clearly visible lump on my collarbone. Luckily it doesn't hurt, it just feels uncomfortable from time to time. In the middle of the summer of 2016, I went to Bai Chay hospital for examination. The doctors diagnosed me with a case of seborrhea - a benign tumor, and advised me to have surgery because it got bigger and more unsightly.

I agree. After surgery to remove the tumor, I thought I would never see it again. But no, the next year 2017, it grew back, even more swollen than before, and festered again. If you take anti-inflammatory drugs, the tumor will still be the same, it will only reduce the pain.

Recently it has become even more swollen, but the whole area is sore, even the slightest touch is painful. For many days, the pain was so painful and it showed no signs of stopping, so on January 1, 2020, I went to the provincial hospital for a check-up. It was a holiday so I could only go to the emergency room. The doctor there examined me and said that the tumor had come back, was inflamed, and had to have minor surgery to remove the tumor.

But I still have to go to work, I can't wait, and too much surgery is not good, maybe it will just grow back like before, so I don't have surgery. Take the car home to buy more medicine. Actually, I drink it to relieve pain, but I don't have any hope. I've taken it many times before but it didn't go away.

A few days ago, a friend gave me a book of the Ksitigarbha Sutra and a notebook to copy the sutra. So that night, I brought it with me when I went on night shift. I didn't have to worry so I took out the scriptures and wrote them down, and it wasn't until morning.

While copying the sutras, I also prayed to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and recited his name to pray for my pain to subside.

Sure enough, a few days later I saw that the pain in the tumor had subsided completely, with only a few occasional sharp pains throughout the day. Gradually it became less swollen and no longer painful to the touch. Just like that, I continued to recite my prayers until the 10th night, and the pain was completely gone. The next morning, I felt it and didn't see any more of the tumor. It had completely disappeared. My collarbone was flat, leaving only the scar from before surgery. Filled with joy, I immediately texted the sister who gave me the prayer book to tell me the good news. Thank you for sowing the fate to help me create great merit, neutralize karma and cure my illness. Not only that, it also makes me plant good roots in Buddha Dharma, the blessings will not end for countless future lives.

(Quang Tu, rewritten from Nguyen Chien's account)

16. Dissolving a Marriage on the Verge

tom_tat: About 2 months ago, I discovered that my husband was acting differently. I secretly followed him and knew he was having an affair. Think about it, after all, my husband is a person of honor and status in society, so am I; If…

Wisdom

About 2 months ago, I discovered that my husband was acting differently. I secretly followed him and knew he was having an affair. Think about it, after all, my husband is a person of honor and status in society, so am I; If this thing breaks down, wouldn't it be embarrassing for both of us? Not to mention children, they have always been very proud of their parents. If they knew, how could they bear it.

Thinking again and again, I chose a peaceful solution, advised my husband to change his mind, and also told the girl to let go of her family.

Unexpectedly, it's not as simple as I thought. For a long time, both of them had been plotting to force me to divorce. Originally a famous and happy family, the appearance of a third person caused chaos in the whole house.

She used her beauty to seduce him; To achieve her goal (money), she defied all means. I had no way to control and restrain the stray horse's desire to roam.

One day, I was at the Buddha's temple, my husband pulled me to the ground, forced me to sign a divorce petition, thinking about my children, I did not agree. Very aggressive, he squeezed my neck hard, threatening me with death.

In an emergency, I let go of all fates, single-mindedly recited the holy name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and entrusted my entire life to Him. Perhaps because we single-mindedly recite the holy name of Bodhisattva, we do not feel pain or discomfort. For some reason, while strangling me, my husband fell to the ground panting.

At the end of the month, I went with some Dharma friends to Ksitigarbha Institute to participate in the Ksitigarbha Dharma conference. As soon as he entered the main hall, thinking about the Bodhisattva's infinite compassion, tears suddenly fell from his eyes. Sincerely repenting of my heavy karma, I suddenly saw Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva smiling. Thinking I was dizzy, I regained my composure and looked closely again, he was indeed smiling at me! Pure, extremely peaceful! I don't know how to describe this feeling properly.

At two o'clock in the afternoon that day, the crowd went to the main hall to celebrate the solemn, pure Dharma assembly to recite the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows.

The day of the Ksitigarbha dharma conference, the husband and the girl took each other to the nightclub to have fun, only to come back late at night, and even deliberately told stories about the fun to annoy me. I didn't pay attention, still peacefully holding the child and sleeping.

Four days in a row like that, suddenly after returning from going out, he cried and asked for forgiveness. I found it strange and didn't know what I was trying to do. I told my husband that if he really wanted to change things, he should come and repent and swear to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

He later recounted that while he was at the disco, having fun and dancing, suddenly a very tall person came in front of him and then disappeared, but as if he had heard the person's advice:

“Go home quickly, don't keep going back and forth with this woman, go back and apologize to your wife and children, don't destroy your happy home.”

At the same time, the other girl also dreamed of a tall man coming to threaten her: "Destroying your family, causing husband and wife and children to be separated, that retribution is too much for you to bear. You should not stay confused and not wake up..."

The two of them thought back, were extremely scared, and automatically broke up.

The reason my family was able to overcome the storm and return to peace can be said to be entirely thanks to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's inconceivably compassionate and majestic power. My husband realized that he was at fault, tried his best to make up for his old mistakes, started studying Buddhist scriptures, and gradually understood the profound meanings in them.

Thanks to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, I was able to build a Buddhist family, everyone in the family knows how to return to rely on the Three Jewels, eat vegetarian food, recite Buddha's name, make merit...

(Excerpt from the book "The Holy Virtues and Inspiration of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva")

17. Saving Living Beings From Hell

Thuy Huong – member of the group ‘Cause and Effect - Samsara’

(…continued from “Repentance with snails”, “Repentance with pigs”)

Dear friends, I am very grateful that after sharing my own stories of repentance (posts 'Repentance with snails', 'Repentance with pigs'), many of you have joined me in sincerely repenting for the mistakes you have made

Today, on the occasion of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's death day, July 29, I would like to offer to the public another inspiring story when reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra, which I myself never dared to think that I could do. As mentioned in the previous two articles, I often recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra in my free time during the day. In the early years when I first started chanting, one evening, like every day, I was concentrating on the sutra when I was suddenly startled to hear a very loud 'clinking' sound. If you listen closely, you can clearly hear the sound of chains rattling. Because I know my cultivation power is still weak, I always tell myself to be alert to the realms happening around me. I ignored it, still focusing on the unfinished prayer. But the 'clinking' sound continued to ring in my ears, this time it sounded like nails scraping the ground. At this moment, I felt extremely angry at myself for not focusing on reciting the sutras, and instead wandering around listening, making myself restless.

To calm my mind, I closed my eyes, took a deep breath, and after a while, I heard a loud scream: “Save me, please save me..”

I looked around curiously and was frightened. I saw two people who people often call "buffalo head, horse face" who were very tall. They are truly terrifyingly big, in the universe there are truly people who are different from us. They all wore armor that was as hard as iron, the skin rough but sturdy, their feet wore animal skin shoes, their bodies were slightly bent because they were half human and half animal, each of them was holding a long chain that scraped the ground. It turned out that the jingling sound was coming from here.

The two men were dragging a woman's feet, she was too small compared to the two good prisoners, her whole body was probably only as high as their knees. The woman was wearing a white shirt, bleeding profusely, her hair wet with sweat. Because the 'buffalo head, horse face' was pulling her legs prone, she tried her best to pin 10 fingers to the ground, making a terrible sound. Actually, she didn't understand that she was being taken to hell, but was just too afraid of those two giants, with human bodies but animal faces.

Seemingly knowing that I was looking in that direction, she screamed even louder: "Save me, save me..., please save me..."

As a novice lay practitioner, I just stared wide-eyed without knowing what to do. I'm afraid, really afraid that one day I will be dragged like her. What should I do?

While they were confused, the other two suddenly turned their heads. Buddha! I just want to faint to avoid seeing this scene. The two of them bared their teeth and looked like their limbs were falling apart. Honestly, at that time I was so scared, so I thought that if I were bitten, my body would probably break in half. Because I didn't know what to do, I just sat motionless, watching her being dragged further and further away... Then, suddenly she shouted very loudly: "Recite Buddha, recite Buddha for me." As if by inertia, I quickly recited Buddha: "Namo Amitabha Buddha, Namo Great Vow Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva..." I chanted continuously, my legs still neatly crossed. Both hands clasped in front of chest. At this moment, my whole body and mind just wanted to save her.

Please recite Buddha's name often, whenever and wherever you want to cultivate the habit of reciting Buddha's name in advance, because if you do not often recite Buddha's name in advance, in these critical times, you cannot recite the Buddha's name. After reciting a few sentences, a very strange thing happened, the two 'buffalo heads and horse faces' suddenly stopped. They seemed surprised, why in this time of distress, that girl still knew to ask me to recite Buddha's name. I heard a "thud" sound, they let her legs down and stopped pulling. Suddenly, everything sank into nothingness. I still sat there but it was absolutely quiet.

As if coming out of a trance, I hastily continued the unfinished prayer. This time, in addition to repenting to the unjust bondholders, I also dedicated myself and told myself to do some good deeds so that she could escape hell. Normally, each time I recite the sutra it only takes about half an hour (a third of the Ksitigarbha Sutra). But that day alone, from the time I opened the sutra, saw that incident and continued reciting the sutra, it took 3 hours. Perhaps, the process of observing what I just mentioned probably took about 2 hours.

Normally, I am too lazy to recite sutras. But after seeing that scene, he recited diligently every day. Actually, I wanted to quickly save that girl rather than repent for myself because I thought that if I was not diligent and sincere in saving her, she would forever fall into hell, and the chance of returning to her human body would be very difficult. That's why I always take advantage of my free time during the day to recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, some days I recite one book three times. Thinking back, I feel so ashamed because at that time I was incompetent and not diligent at all. Day after day, I regularly dedicated my merits to her. My heart secretly hopes that even though she falls into hell, she will still come back one day to atone for her sins. I never dared to think that I would be lucky enough to meet that girl again.

About half a year later, one night, after chanting, I suddenly felt sleepy. Because I thought that going to work during the day and working hard at night would make my body tired, I immediately went to bed. While daydreaming, I saw a woman wearing a blue and white dress that covered her body. This person seemed to be smiling at me. Oh, that's the woman I saw the other day being dragged away by 'buffalo head - horse face', but now she looks very peaceful, not scared like before.

I tried to raise my eyes and get up but I couldn't. The distance she stood was very close to me, and for some reason, when I looked at her, my heart felt a love, an indescribable closeness.

She looked at me and smiled gently, her head slightly nodding as if to say thank you. Then that image gradually disappeared into nothingness. I'm not sure if you can guess that the girl was escaped from the gates of hell, is that true, dear wise friends? Me too, at that time I felt very happy, at least I was able to save one sentient being from hell. Thinking more later, I understood one thing. If I didn't practice diligently, I would be dragged away like that, not an exception.

Because my respect for Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is very deep, I feel good about it. I hope all of you will join me in trying to change your body and mind. Do good and avoid evil. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva saves life and death for us every day. Just one moment of thinking and reverence for Him, no matter how difficult it is, hell fire burns our body, He will provide us with the conditions to help us find enlightenment. Once again, I would like to recite "Namo Great Vow to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva!!!". I pray to be your disciple forever and ever, without turning back.

Hoang Tu Huong moved from the countryside to the city to work as a laborer. Every night, she had nightmares that made her wake up startled and panicked. She was extremely frightened, immediately chanting: "Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva!"

Just reciting a few sentences, she saw a monk holding a staff in his hand appear, pointing at her and telling a few villains: "This is my person, you are not allowed to arrest her." After he finished speaking, those evil people left and she was safe. Waking up, she felt that this dream was very strange.

Two months later, a few friends from the countryside visited and invited her to go to Fujian to work, with a monthly salary of more than seven million, and an advance payment of three and a half million called an advance allowance to take care of the family at home. She was very happy to hear that, so she quickly prepared her luggage. But the next day I had a severe stomach ache and constant diarrhea, so I couldn't go, secretly regretting losing my chance.

Half a year later, I heard news from my hometown: Those girls were tricked by a group of vicious gangsters into going to Fujian and then sold to Taiwan as prostitutes. Only then did she remember the strange dream she had before. Because of that, my belief in the miraculous power of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva increases.
