19. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Protects the Entire Family

After my father quit working at the power company and stayed home to rest for a while, he always felt uncomfortable and unable to adapt to being idle. At that time, near my house, construction had just begun on the temple to worship Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Due to limited funds, during breaks and work, all the projects depended on the dedication of the people. On weekdays, very few people come to offer incense to Buddha. During the day, they only hear the tap-knock-knock-knock sound of the workers, and at night, they hear the beggars returning to stay. Behind the palace, there is a small house, filled with miscellaneous items, most of which are the remains of homeless people. The situation without anyone managing it is even more tragic, the scene is truly heartbreaking! Seeing such a pitiful scene, his father was determined to do good deeds and took on the responsibility of managing the palace, day and night, always present to look after and take care of him. During the past 20 years, my father has created a great karma with Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. That karma not only helped the whole family become devout followers of Buddhism, but also received compassionate blessings from the Bodhisattva, and often had special effects. Now I would like to briefly write down to appreciate that heavenly grace.

Parents are blessed by Buddha:

Before my father retired, all his internal organs were seriously ill, sometimes healthy, sometimes weak, no one dared to say when the disease would heal or not develop. Recently I took my father to the hospital for a re-examination, the test results showed that an old man was 76 years old, but his body was still very healthy, his eyes were clear, his memory was good, even the doctors were surprised, they were all impressed, it was truly inconceivable.

On the evening of the 12th day of the 7th lunar month last year, my father had to go out on urgent business, because the road surface was full of potholes, plus the sky was pitch black, he groped around and broke his femur, the family took him to the hospital, X-ray was taken, the doctor said very pessimistically:

- Surgery is needed to fuse the two ends of the bone, but it must be operated at least twice, saying that the probability of success is only half, and then you have to rest and recuperate for at least half a year to recover.

Listening to the doctor, the whole family could only look at each other, worried. How can an organ like that be able to withstand the pain of surgery? Suddenly, a premonition came and his father was transferred to a talented broken bone healer. In less than two months, his father was able to walk again, just walking a little slower than before, but no abnormalities were seen. Thanks to the Bodhisattva's energy, my father not only escaped the suffering of being cut by a knife, but his body was also healthier than before.

When my mother was still alive, she suffered from diabetes and had to be hospitalized several times. After being discharged from the hospital, she immediately went to Ksitigarbha Palace to help her father deal with work and do meritorious deeds. Every day was the same, both grandparents went to the palace to care and worry. During this time there were many strange stories! One time, my mother was cleaning the Bodhisattva Palace upstairs and accidentally slipped and fell down. According to the situation at that time, if she fell from the stairs like that, if she hadn't broken a bone, she would have been seriously injured. However, my mother only had a small bruise on her thigh. After applying medicine for a few days, it healed. In the last years of her life, her mother's diabetes became more and more severe, and in the end she had to accept impermanence and pass away. However, she must thank the Bodhisattva's compassion and protection, helping her mother pass away peacefully and gently, without being beset by pain, without being entangled by family affection and losing her righteous thoughts. I firmly believe that with my mother's sincere devotion and respect, Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha would definitely have guided me to rebirth. Bodhisattva helps me grow in faith:

Even though my parents believe in Buddhism, since I was young, I have had the idea that Buddhism is a superstitious, mythical, nonsense religion, and I look down on beliefs, so I often argue with my mother. But Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva did not give up. He created the cause and condition and skillfully guided me.

That was an incident that happened 15 years ago. That year I had to change places of work several times. In the end, I couldn't find any place, so I had to stay at home to pass the days. While I was at home, I was worried and uneasy. First, because my brother was about to get married, I was an adult girl and had to take responsibility for helping the family. Second, it was not easy to find a job at the end of the year. I read the newspaper looking for a job, saw that there were relatively good jobs posted, and thought: If I don't work and just stay at home and live with my parents, my sister-in-law will definitely laugh at me, so finding a job is the problem that occupies my whole mind. The pressure became more and more severe, part of me was worried and restless, part of me had no one to confide in, and in the end the only way was to have the idea of ​​asking Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for help. After the Tet holiday, sure enough, I received a notice from a quite famous company, with a generous salary, and promised to call them in the afternoon to let me know the results. I was very happy, I kept looking forward to the afternoon, at the appointed time, picked up the phone and called, said a few words, the other end answered:

- Sorry! Quantity is limited, if there is a chance in the future, we will let you know!

My mind is dark, I don't know anything anymore, all my plans and dreams have now collapsed.

I lamented not knowing when I would find a job. Not knowing who inspired me, I went up to the altar, burned incense, knelt down and prayed to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. The next morning, I was about to go out for a walk to relieve my headache, but suddenly the post office brought a letter. I quickly took it apart and read: "Sorry! Yesterday afternoon, because the phone was too low, I couldn't speak clearly, so please come to the company this afternoon to pick up the job." I couldn't believe my eyes anymore, I didn't know if I was awake or dreaming, I was so happy I couldn't describe it! From then on, he began to affirm his belief in Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

My older sister has studied Buddhism for 10 years. Both she and her father received the Bodhisattva vows at Phat Quang mountain, and were born in a Buddhist family. Having often heard of it, she was influenced by it, plus personally experiencing it herself, so naturally she also followed her to the Infinite Life Map Monastery of Phat Quang Mountain branch in Hsinchu to study and research Buddha's liberation method. After each participation in a Dharma conference, my heart feels light, peaceful, and peaceful beyond words, as if I have "concentrated". Recently, I devoted myself to studying the Sutra Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows, reading the vow "To help sentient beings to the fullest extent to attain Bodhi, I will never be able to attain Buddhahood in hell." (Only by saving all sentient beings can one attain Bodhi, one cannot attain Buddhahood in hell). I was filled with admiration and reverence for that great aspiration.

(Zhu Wufei - The Holy Virtue and Inspiration of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva)

tieu_de: 20. Chanting the Ksitigarbha Sutra Helps the Family to Be Peaceful
tom_tat: Lac Duong Street, Ha Nam Province, there is a family of three people, the husband is honest, the wife is diligent and capable, their daughter, 17 years old, is beautiful and lovely. At first glance, it appears that this is a warm and happy family, but really...
noi_dung:
20. Chanting the Ksitigarbha Sutra Helps Families Be Peaceful

(Excerpt from Retribution in the Present Life 3 - Qua Khanh)

Lac Duong Street, Henan Province, there is a family of three people, the husband is honest, the wife is diligent and capable, their daughter, 17 years old, is beautiful and lovely. At first glance, it appears that this is a warm and happy family, but it is true as the proverb says "every house has its troubles that are hard to talk about".

By chance, my wife came to me to confess her unspeakable suffering over the years.

She and her husband came from rural areas, and before getting married, they had no feelings or knew each other before. It was just that when they met, she saw that he was quiet and cautious in his gestures, so she thought to herself: "This is a man with good manners and style, worthy of being relied on...", so she agreed to get married.

After getting married, she discovered that her husband had too many disabilities that she couldn't handle.

For example, when he eats rice, he chews it very coarsely. She said, if he ate noodles, the neighbors upstairs and downstairs could clearly hear him chewing, swallowing, and slurping. When eating, even though his nose was "flowing like a river", he didn't bother to wipe it or raise his head, he just kept eating - regardless of whether there were guests at home or not.

Furthermore, once he farts, he just lets it out naturally, without any embarrassment or shyness, fireworks from his butt keep exploding, continuously or sporadically... making those present confused and embarrassed to no end, but he calmly stays calm as if nothing happened. No matter how bitterly she advised, her husband remained as inert as "an elm tree with all its bark peeled off", just "I am as I am", with an unchanged appearance.

The stories told like this sound very trivial, but there have been many quarrels between husband and wife because of this. She saw that her husband was truly willing to be laughed at, let people comment and gossip during the time of drinking and drinking without even feeling embarrassed, as if he had no face... He made her and her daughter extremely embarrassed in front of outsiders!

Therefore, she discussed divorce many times, but was often discouraged by friends and relatives. As for her, whenever she sees her husband, her heart is filled with frustration and sadness.

Her daughter lacked her father's love from an early age - she was never held, played with or taken out by him. As for his father, he was also full of dissatisfaction, because he rarely talked to his father and was treated like a stranger by him.

Up to now, whenever mother and son are talking and laughing, as soon as he enters the house, they immediately shut up.

Since taking refuge in Buddhism, her daughter and grandmother both gave up eating salty foods. Every day she persistently practiced the morning and evening sessions, diligently chanting sutras and mantras. Her daughter is busy with school, so every day she takes the opportunity to recite the Great Compassion Mantra, which seems to be very diligent and diligent.

For everything, she can let it go, let it all go. The only problem with her husband was that her mind often became upset. She always hoped that through diligent practice, the sufferings of marriage would be reduced. Who knew that since she became a vegetarian, she couldn't stand the smell on her husband's body, so she had to separate rooms so no one paid attention to anyone else.

They have been sleeping separately for three years now. She originally waited for her daughter to go to college next year to get a divorce. Because she has to face afflictions and suffering every day, she often has headaches and is very sick.

Looking at the woman crying, she was only over 40 years old, but was tormented by an unhappy marriage and tortured by illness, making her emaciated.

I knew that this was a gathering of evil predestined relationships from previous lives, not easy for ordinary people like me to resolve, so I called to instruct the Venerable Dieu Phap (a high-ranking monk with enough intelligence to see the cause and effect of other people's karma). The master was silent for a moment and then explained the past lives of the mother, daughter and husband:

- This female layperson in her previous life was a poor man living in the mountains, making a living by picking medicine. One day, he took the medicine down to the store in the town under the mountain to sell it. The shop owner told him:

- It is said that on the mountain there is a thousand-year-old elm tree whose bark makes extremely valuable medicine. Because the mountains are so high and dangerous, few people are willing to go there. If you can get the shell to sell, you will definitely make a fortune and make a lot of money!

After hearing this, he was very happy and secretly calculated that the money he earned this time would be spent on getting married.

After finishing preparations, he climbed the pass, waded through the stream, up the high mountain and finally found an elm tree as big as three people could hug. He was so happy to have fulfilled his dream that he took the ax and started peeling off the bark. After working for a long time, he was tired, so he set his ax on the ground, climbed up a tree to lie down and sleep.

While sleeping soundly, he suddenly saw a young man wearing a green shirt kneeling in front of him crying, saying that he was an elm tree, and had been cultivating for a thousand years. Only three more years to go before he attains enlightenment and becomes an immortal. If all the bark is peeled off now, we will be in a situation where "our efforts will be exhausted", so I beg you to kindly extend and relax; So that three years later, when I come to peel the shell, I will cultivate to become an immortal and then repay my gratitude. After speaking, he immediately bowed to him a few times.

At that time he shouted loudly:

- No way, no way! I need to get married, I can't wait three years!

Then he suddenly woke up, the young man in blue shirt was nowhere to be seen! He finally peeled off all the bark from the elm tree and carried it to the pharmacy. The shop owner happily checked the goods and weighed and measured them. Because he was illiterate, he quickly said:

- I worked very hard to bring back the precious medicine, you must not weigh it falsely or deceive me!

The shop owner immediately replied:

- Rest assured! If I lie, I will do... your child!

That man in this life is this lay woman, her husband is the thousands-year-old elm tree that encountered a disaster and had its skin stripped off. The proverb says: “People need faces, trees need bark!”

Doesn't the laywoman often say that her husband behaves like: "a stripped elm tree" with no face, no skin, no face? Indeed, what she said was very right! We must know that personality, habits and what people have encountered or experienced in previous lives greatly influence this life.

The owner of the pharmacy actually cheated on the medicine picker by two ounces. Because of the oath "if I lied, I would be... your child!", so now he has to be born as a child, but no longer as a boy but as a girl.

Because it was he who initiated, instructed and incited him to peel off the bark of the elm tree, destroying the tree's thousand-year karma, so his sins were many.

That's why in this life he has to be reincarnated as a child in a family that is against him (having a female body compared to a male body is much more miserable), not to mention being a child who is not loved or cared for by his father, so isn't that suffering even more suffering? This is also the reason for the unusual, extremely cold relationship between father and daughter.

Understanding the cause and effect of previous lives in this life, lay women and their daughters need to sincerely repent of their previous life's sins. She needs to repent to her husband in this life. Daughters must also persevere in repentance to erase the resentment in their father's heart (the reason he is such an unreasonable person today is due to the actions of mother and daughter in their previous lives). The mother and daughter must later sincerely repent and recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra 49 times for the sake of the "old elm tree".

When the right conditions come together and the moment comes, the three people's family relationships will definitely improve, and they will enjoy profound love.

Perhaps thanks to the lay woman and her daughter's dedication to practice (diligently chanting sutras, reciting mantras, and fasting and reciting Buddha's name for nearly three years now), they were inspired.

Perhaps it was their fate that they had mastered, so when I conveyed all the root causes that Venerable Dieu Phap had just taught, she and her mother suddenly woke up as if in a dream, happily accepting it.

Especially her daughter, both surprised and happy, told her mother:

- Mom! Mom and Dad lived together for more than ten years, but Mom kept angrily blaming Dad for "no face and no skin!" Turns out it was my mother's fault, she took away all of my father's skin, that's why it ended up like that...

This statement made everyone at the scene laugh.

Half a month later, a laywoman from Luoyang called to give good news, saying her headache was completely gone and other illnesses were also much lighter. Now it only takes two hours for her to finish reciting a set of Ksitigarbha Sutra, and her husband has gradually changed.

She was determined to finish reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra 49 times. After that, I will continue to recite one set each day, dedicating it to sentient beings throughout the Dharma Realm, praying that all can hear the Ksitigarbha Sutra, understand its principles, and enjoy the benefits.

After hearing this, I was really happy for her, wishing them to soon become a harmonious, happy Buddhist family.

21. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Helping Those Who Are Reborn

tom_tat: Near my house, there is a layperson couple of the Ngo family, both of whom have returned to take refuge in the Three Jewels, with a kind, gentle, and honest personality. The layman currently owns a fairly large company. Since returning to take refuge in the Three Jewels, he has diligently studied...
noi_dung:
Dieu Hanh

Near my house, there is a layman and his wife named Ngo, both of whom have returned to take refuge in the Three Jewels, with a kind, gentle, and honest personality. The layman owns a fairly large company. Since returning to take refuge in the Three Jewels, he has diligently studied and practiced the Buddha's method of liberation, enthusiastically supporting ashrams everywhere. In mid-July this year (the 79th year of the Republic of China), his lay father passed away peacefully after being ill for more than a year. The lay couple regularly practices diligently and righteously in the Three Jewels, organizes their father's funeral in the spirit of Buddhist teachings, and requests Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha to compassionately help their father eliminate karma and freely reborn.

When Ngo Thai Thai told me about her good appearance when her father-in-law passed away, her face still showed joy. She said:

“When my father-in-law was alive, he loved to eat fish and meat. He hardly missed a meal. By late afternoon, his body was weak, suffering from illness, and his body and mind were tired. At this time, he often saw dead relatives and hungry ghosts standing around the bed, one or two demanding to take him away; all day long he lay paralyzed in bed, taking good care of him, still suffering from ulcers and very uncomfortable stench. My husband and I advised my father to return to take refuge in the Three Jewels, first and foremost. Contemplating Amitabha Buddha's kindness and reciting Amitabha Buddha's holy name, relying on His grace, helped ease his father's pain. Fortunately, he happily obeyed, especially on the 15th day of the 7th lunar month last year, he proactively vowed to become a vegetarian, lying in bed all day reciting Amitabha Buddha's holy name; from then on, he no longer saw the wrongful, familiar, or disturbing spirit, and no longer smelled the bad smells Ulcers on the body gradually dry up.

A few days before he passed away, my father-in-law happily told me and my husband several times that he often saw lakes and majestic flower gardens, and also heard wonderful, wonderful sounds. Until he closed his eyes, his face was as peaceful as a person sleeping, showing no signs of pain. After my father-in-law passed away, my husband and I recited the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows every night, praying that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's compassion would help him eliminate unjust karma from beginningless kalpas to the present.

Yesterday morning, after their father-in-law passed away, everyone took turns reciting Amitabha Buddha's holy name for 21 hours before starting to bathe and change clothes; At that time, the body was even softer than usual. After shrouding, on the 7th day, the ashes are taken to the crematorium, the ashes are worshiped in the house's shrine, and after the worshiping ceremony, the ashes are brought to be placed in the Ksitigarbha."

On the afternoon of putting the bones there, on the occasion of Ksitigarbha's July Dharma Assembly, the whole lay family went into the main hall together, praying for the old man's intermediate body to rely on the power of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, to eliminate old karma, leave the path of suffering, and soon be born in a good land or reborn in the Pure Land. At the end of the Dharma conference, Layman Ngo happily ran to tell me:

- When I had just finished reciting the lower volume of the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, and finished reciting His holy name, I saw with my own eyes the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva on the second floor radiating light. I reached down to lead my father's intermediate body up into the void. I became more and more confident in reciting Bodhisattva's holy name, until that light disappeared.

I heard this story, praising their filial piety for inspiring the Bodhisattva's compassionate vows, leading their father to transcendence, not falling into the three evil paths.

Ngo Thai Thai continued:

After making the second retreat for her father's return, one day her husband's brother-in-law dreamed that Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha led her father-in-law straight forward, going through each door one by one. At the fourth door, he stopped for a moment. Because that door had not yet been opened, Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha used his staff to knock on it. The door immediately opened wide. Bodhisattva urged his father: "Quickly go through, don't come back!" My father-in-law continued to follow Bodhisattva straight; After passing through the sixth door, I suddenly saw light flooding everywhere, and my brother-in-law suddenly woke up. I'm so happy because my father-in-law was guided by the compassionate Bodhisattva and was definitely born in a good realm.

This is all thanks to the sincerity and earnestness of the children, especially the two children, in making offerings, admiring and bowing to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, to receive such a profound response. In countless eons ago, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva once made great vows, compassionately displayed inconceivable divine power, saved and protected all sinful and suffering sentient beings in the 10 worlds, and helped sentient beings attain the joy of Nirvana. – I said.

Ngo Thai Thai nodded and continued:

Remember the last time the Ksitigarbha Institute held the Ksitigarbha Dharma Assembly. Although it was announced that there was a storm, the whole family decided to drive to attend the Dharma Assembly. While the dharma assembly was being held, it was pouring rain outside, the wind was roaring, it seemed like there was some invisible force blocking the wind from blowing into the pagoda. Everyone still calmly sat and focused on reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra, not disturbed by outside circumstances, until after the dharma assembly was completed, the whole family drove back despite the wind and rain to Anh Hoa. Otherwise, it would only take an hour and a half to get home, but this time it took four hours to arrive. Thanks to everyone single-mindedly reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's holy name along the way, we were able to return safely!

After listening, I praised him beyond words. I found a passage in the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra and showed it to Mrs. Wu, confirming that what the Buddha taught was true and not false: "According to the bad karma that person has created, considering the retribution, that person should have fallen into an evil path, but thanks to a loved one cultivating the karma to become a saint for that person, all of that person's crimes are eliminated. After that person If that person has died, during the 49 days, relatives can cultivate many blessings for the dead person, which will help the dead person avoid falling into evil paths and be born in heaven or in the human world and enjoy many great joys; at the same time, the loved one will also receive countless benefits”.

22. Advising Pure Land Cultivators to Chant the Ksitigarbha Sutra or Recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Name to Support the Virtue

tom_tat: This time I met you in Wing Chun because there were many great opportunities. Last summer, layperson Vuong Mong Tinh sent a letter. Before that, I also promised some laypeople, like Lam Tu Kien... Pho Te pagoda would come to preach sutras....
noi_dung:
Master Hoang Nhat

This time I met you in Wing Chun, because there were many great opportunities. Last summer, layperson Vuong Mong Tinh sent a letter. Before that, I also promised some laypeople, like Lam Tu Kien... Pho Te pagoda would come to preach sutras. I came once in late autumn to preach the main ideas of the Diamond Sutra for three days. In July, I closed my retreat to practice meditation and did not go down the mountain again. Yesterday, layperson Mong Tinh and a number of monks went up the mountain to consult. It was raining so they stayed at the temple to rest overnight. This morning is the day of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Holy Birthday. Taking advantage of this wonderful fate, I would like to briefly outline the essential instructions: "Pure Land practitioners should recite the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows", to commemorate his Holy Birthday.

The practice method of those practicing the Pure Land method is to take the three sutras that talk about the Pure Land as the main ones. I think that in addition to those three sutras, you should recite the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra as an aid to your practice. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has a very special karma with sentient beings in this world. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows Sutra is especially suitable for all abilities and all levels, so I dare to advise all of you to recite more of this sutra. Now I just want to briefly say, hope you have a wise choice:

First, from ancient times until now Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has had a very profound affinity with the Pure Land. For example, the 8th patriarch, Great Master Lien Tri, wrote the preface to the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, praising and encouraging its transmission. The 9th Patriarch is Great Master Nguu Ich, who spent his entire life serving Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, praising and praising his inconceivable merits. He stayed on Cuu Hoa mountain for a long time, calling himself a "disciple of the Bodhisattva", practicing repentance rituals according to Ksitigarbha Repentance, often reciting Ksitigarbha's mantra, praying to eliminate karma and seek birth in the Pure Land. Like the Thai Dou star of the contemporary Pure Land sect - Great Master An Quang, he tried his best to propagate the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows, he printed tens of thousands of volumes, helping people who practice pure karma with sincerity to read, recite, and follow the teachings and maintenance. Now, based on the virtues and deeds of previous ancestors, I advise all of you to recite and recite the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows and practice the Dharma teachings of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Combining many wonderful causes and conditions, achieving the path and results is only a matter of time.

Second, the Ksitigarbha dharma method takes three main sutras, which are: Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows Sutra, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Ten Wheels Sutra and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma. The Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra does not clearly state the meaning of rebirth in the Pure Land, but the remaining two sutras do mention it. The Ten Rings Sutra states: "Rebirth in the Buddha's land, living with the master." The Contemplation Sutra records: "Whoever wants to be born in the Pure Land should be single-minded and undisturbed, single-mindedly reciting the holy name of that Buddha (Amitabha Buddha). Anyone who can practice these words will definitely be born in the Land of Ultimate Bliss." Therefore, the ninth great master of the Lotus Sect, Nguoi Ich, every time he worships Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Contemplation and Repentance, he vows: "I vow that when I leave this body and life, I will be born before the Buddha, meet Amitabha Buddha and the Buddhas, be accepted by them, and then return to the world to save all sentient beings and be born together in the Land of Peace." Through this we can see that the Ksitigarbha dharma has a very close relationship with the Pure Land dharma, so why not practice it at the same time, bringing both into one?

Third, in the Infinite Life Sutra, cultivating the three blessings is taken as the main cause of pure karma. The first of the three blessings is "filial piety and nurturing of parents". In the Sutra, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows, there are many causes and conditions in previous lives for Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to be filial to his parents. This is the reason why the ancient monks called the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra the "Buddhist filial piety sutra", the benefits are very practical. Good friends in general, and associated friends in particular, should single-mindedly recite the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, to help with the nurturing intention that the Infinite Life Sutra advocates. Practice both together, worship filial piety, repay gratitude, and at the same time cultivate superior blessings.

Fourth, the contemporary Pure Land master - An Quang - teaches people to recite the holy name of Buddha to seek rebirth in the Pure Land, first of all they must deeply believe in cause and effect and retribution, do not do evil deeds, focus on doing good deeds. Finally, he said: "Relying on the magnetic power of Father Amitabha's virtue, you will be reborn while your body still has karma." The Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Vow Sutra also talks a lot and is very clear about cause and effect and retribution, as thoroughly as possible. Good friends should regularly read and recite the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows, practice accordingly, and practice meritorious deeds to purify karma. People who do not deeply believe in cause and effect and retribution will not pay attention to the practicality of morality and ethics. This person should not expect to be reborn in the Pure Land, because the three evil paths are already waiting. I think that you all need to deeply believe in cause and effect and retribution, often reflect and review the things you do every day. Sincerely repent and make new efforts. Then practice the Five Moral Principles, Ten Good Things, etc., to assist in reciting the Buddha's name, contributing to the well-being of rebirth.

Fifth, if a person practices the Pure Land method, if he or she is not able to let go of all suffering, happiness and reversibility, he will not be able to attain the realm of liberation. If you are able to rely on suffering to eliminate the view of the body24 (one of the five views), and use adverse conditions to solidify your Pure Land vow, then the sublime realm will appear right before your eyes. But there are only one or two out of thousands of people who truly can do this. Because most of us are in the position of ordinary people, although we know that depending on our ability and strength to practice pure karma, if we are not sufficiently qualified to clearly understand our body, mind and the outside world, we are not capable of taking food, clothing, shelter, etc. lightly; The mind is not calm in the face of disasters such as natural disasters, fierce fire, war, hunger and thirst...; This harsh and difficult situation is the biggest obstacle for practitioners in general and practitioners of pure karma in particular. Now if we can return to rely on Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha, we will no longer have to worry about this matter. According to the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, Bodhisattva Bodhisattva has the ability to make sentient beings have enough clothes and food, illness does not affect their body, their house is peaceful, their wishes are satisfied, their life span increases, when they come in and out, they are protected by gods, and accidents are not violated. The ancients said: "The body's peace of mind increases", that is exactly what it means. Therefore, I advise all of you to rely on the essential teachings of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

The above is a summary of the general idea of reciting the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows. Although the meaning is not clear, it is still relatively complete. I hope all beings can gather this point and encourage everyone to develop their minds to recite the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Basic Vows, together achieving boundless benefits.

23. Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha Dream of Relief from Suffering

tom_tat: Last summer, I took my mother to the Central region to visit my younger sister who I hadn't seen for several years. As soon as you step into the middle room, you see that the house has two holy statues of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, incense burning, looking very solemn and pure...
noi_dung:
Thanh Ha

Last summer, I took my mother to the Central region to visit my younger brother whom I had not seen for several years. As soon as I entered the middle room, I saw that the house had two holy statues of Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha, with incense burning, looking extremely solemn and pure, I clasped my hands in prayer. Right at the time she was worshiping Buddha. Waiting for my aunt to finish the ceremony and sit down on her chair, I respectfully said:

Auntie! How long has it been since you returned to take refuge in the Three Jewels? Auntie laughed cheerfully:

Thank you very much for the blessings of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas of the 10 directions. If it weren't for the Three Jewels, I would have fallen into hell.

I didn't understand what she meant. I was full of doubts and asked:

What is the cause and condition? Why did she make up her mind to return to take refuge in the Three Jewels? I didn't expect that after just a few years of not seeing her, my aunt would change so much!

My aunt stared at the holy statue of Bodhisattva, reminiscing: "A few years ago, I visited an old friend's house and saw that there was a holy statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Looking at the statue, I suddenly felt extremely happy. I didn't understand what was the motive that made me clasp my hands together in prayer, but after leaving, I couldn't remember anything anymore. Now I feel extremely regretful. Before that, no matter what holiday, I would kill a lot of animals to make offerings. That day. On March 23rd of the lunar calendar, two years ago, on the occasion of the appearance of the holy mother Ma To, everyone's family sacrificed animals; her family was a famous rich family in the area and was a devout follower of Ma To. Of course, she killed more chickens and ducks than other families to make 20 feasts, inviting friends to eat, drink, and sing. She thought that this was a great honor and merit, but she thought that she had encouraged more people to believe in Ma To. So, you will definitely be blessed by Ma To.

After eating and drinking, everyone left after 8 o'clock. She entertained guests, ran up and down, was busy all day, and was extremely tired. As soon as the guest returned, she asked the resident to get hot water for her to bathe in, then go to bed to rest. But for some reason, I tossed and turned and still couldn't sleep. Late at night it was quiet, suddenly the rain and wind roared, she felt a shiver inside her body. She smelled the room full of blood, and heard the sounds of chickens and ducks... screaming. Uncomfortable, wanting to vomit, having difficulty breathing, wanting to call but unable to call, her whole body stiffened, she fainted without knowing it.

Woke up early the next morning, my whole body was in pain, I couldn't lift my arms or legs, couldn't move, my eyes were dark, my face was pale... A serious illness started, I lay unconscious, my breathing gradually weakened. In the maze, she found herself in a very deep, dark place that nothing could compare to. She was scared and panicked, calling for help. Suddenly, a beam of light appeared above, shining straight to her body, helping her to lose her fear and feel extremely safe. A monk with an appearance like a full moon, wearing a ka-sa, came out from that light. He reached out to pull her up, and she was saved. The aunt followed the teacher to a spacious and bright place. The teacher gently said: "You are Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva that you worshiped at your friend's house a few years ago! Because you have killed too many lives, so they come to claim you, and will not let you go at all costs. After you die, you will definitely fall into hell and experience immeasurable suffering. However, thanks to a single sincere thought, a joyful mind is born when contemplating the image of the teacher, and one is exempted from the crime of hell and does not suffer retribution. Right now, the bad karma in me still exists. From now on, I should sincerely repent, make a new vow, absolutely not kill anymore, love and protect sentient beings, often give alms, and do good deeds to accumulate merit." Having said that, he immediately disappeared.

Waking up, she still remembered clearly what happened in the dream. She told it to the whole family. Everyone was skeptical, not knowing if it was true or not. But seeing that her illness improved significantly, she returned from the dead. It can be said that this is a miracle. She went to the pagoda to pay her respects and asked to return to take refuge in the Three Jewels, and invited the Bodhisattva statue to worship and make offerings. Early in the morning, every day, recite the Bodhisattva's holy name. At night, faithfully recite a volume of the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, dedicating the merit to the living beings who have been killed by her for countless eons until now, praying for them to have their karma eliminated, neutralize their hatred, and soon be reincarnated to a good path; Since then, she has stopped raising animals and killing living beings. She regularly makes offerings to the Three Jewels, listens to Buddha's teachings, gives Buddhist scriptures, is generous with Buddha, does not do evil deeds, diligently does good deeds, and skillfully advises people to do good at first. The whole family lives in love, gentleness and joy, is chosen by everyone as a cultured family, everyone around them admires and follows them. She was extremely happy, even though she still felt ashamed.

At this point, my aunt was so happy that she couldn't speak anymore. I heard the stories my aunt experienced and the vision of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva advising others not to kill, and immediately gave rise to the heart of reverence for Bodhisattva and fear of killing. When I returned, I advised my family and neighbors not to kill or sacrifice, otherwise I would be killed by living beings demanding my life, and I would definitely fall into the three evil paths. If we do not have a good relationship with Buddhism, how can we pray to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to rescue us?

24. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Protects From Thieves

noi_dung:
Master Hoang Nhat

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has great inspiration and is considered the first among Bodhisattvas. His inspiration, found mostly in the sutras, now I would like to recommend 28 beneficial things mentioned in the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows.

The Tathagata taught, if in the future there are good men and good women who see the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, listen to this sutra, recite His holy name, use perfume, flowers, food, clothes, treasures to give alms, praise, admire and pay respects, that person will receive 28 benefits:

First, being supported by heaven and dragons (because before that only demons followed).

Second, the good results are increasing day by day (being pursued by evil demons, giving rise to an evil mind to do bad things, causing the evil results to grow. Today it is no longer like that).

Third, gather the causes of the saints (if you do good without making a vow to dedicate, that cause will only be enjoyed in the heavenly and human realms. Now that we understand the path, we will not be as stingy as before and dedicate it to the path of Bodhi).

Fourth, do not regress in the Bodhi path.

Year, food, drink, and clothing are abundant and full.

Sixth, don't get sick.

Seventh, be free from disasters of fire and water.

Eighth, do not be harmed by robbers.

Nine, everyone who sees it also respects and admires it.

Ten, demons and gods follow and protect.

Eleven, female body changes to male body (this life or next life).

Twelve, daughter of kings and ministers.

Thirteen, good and dignified appearance.

Fourteen, most of whom were born in heaven.

Fifteen, or born as a king.

Sixteen, knowing about previous lives.

Seventeen, whatever you want, you will be satisfied.

Eighteen, relatives and friends are harmonious and happy.

Nineteen, destroy disasters.

Twenty, stay away from evil ways.

Twenty-one, no matter where you go, there will be no obstacles.

Twenty-two, have peaceful dreams at night.

Twenty-three, the loved ones have left the suffering.

Twenty-four, if in your previous life you had the blessing of being born in a good land (those who have not yet made the vow to be born in the Pure Land will be born in heaven, as kings, daughters of kings, ministers... now know the Pure Land dharma, everything you do is directed towards the Pure Land).

Twenty-five, praised and praised by the saints.

Twenty-six, smart and alert.

Twenty-seven, have a heart of understanding and compassion.

Twenty-eight, eventually become Buddha.

The above are just a sample of the 28 benefits recorded in the sutra. In fact, if we talk about the benefits of reciting the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, reciting the Bodhisattva's holy name, worshiping, making offerings... it is boundless, it can't be said for a lifetime. But because these 28 benefits are the greatest and at the same time the easiest for people to understand, they should be given so that everyone can develop faith in the Bodhisattva. Furthermore, we should know that all benefits are true and not false. However, there are some people who also respectfully make offerings to the holy statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, but do not see the benefits as mentioned in the sutras, that is because their karma and devotion are not strong enough. If you are able to wholeheartedly and sincerely make offerings, you will definitely receive the benefits as mentioned above. Among those 28 articles, there is the eighth article "not being harmed by robbers". For many years now, I have noticed that this is very true. Now I would like to briefly tell you.

When I was still at home, there was a statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva in the house. At that time, I often offered fresh flowers and incense lamps as offerings, wholeheartedly and respectfully. Later, with all the favorable conditions, he became a monk and vowed to live an awakened life. No matter where he went, he would make offerings to the Bodhisattva statue. About 7 years ago, I spent the summer retreat at a small temple in Hangzhou. In the temple there are three main rooms, divided into six compartments. There is an attic above, storing things, but no one lives there. Downstairs, the middle room is the Buddha hall where the monks worship, the back room is the hall for guests. The two outer rooms are the monks' rooms, while the two middle rooms are reserved for the Venerable and the monk. At that time, the old Venerable was seriously ill and paralyzed in bed. In addition to the Venerable, there were also two monks and a lay person, divided into the remaining rooms. The strange thing about this temple is that the front gate is never open, everyone has to come from the back.

One day, a guest came and saw a large block of stone outside the corner of the wall. He quickly came in and told me:

- This is a sign that the thieves want to enter but cannot.

When I heard that, I paid even more attention, moved all the things upstairs to the room, and at the same time reinforced the windows of all the rooms, telling the brothers to be on guard against thieves, but they didn't believe it. That night, after reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's holy name, my mind was unusually calm and as soon as I lay down I fell into a deep sleep. But in the dark of the night I heard the sound of people moving around upstairs, and a moment later I heard the Venerable's voice again. I thought the Venerable asked someone to help me go upstairs to check the door.

Not long after, I fell asleep. In the morning, as usual, when I opened the door to go practice, I saw the guests' belongings scattered everywhere, papers and books lying on the ground. The brothers ran to tell me:

- Don't you know what happened last night, you are so lucky. - He continued: Last night, a group of bandits broke into the temple, used knives to threaten and drag two monks and a lay monk out, looking for all the money and clothes; After that, forcibly led them to the Venerable's room. We reluctantly had to lead them into the Venerable's room. They forced the Venerable to take them upstairs and open the warehouse. They took more than 200 dong, as for the belongings, they took whatever they wanted, and whatever they didn't want they threw on the ground, then leisurely walked away after taking it.

The bandits searched all the rooms in the temple, only my room they skipped. According to what my brothers told me, the bandits also intended to break into my room, but they kept pulling at the main door and couldn't get out, because inside there was a lintel installed, and after trying for more than an hour to open it, they still couldn't get out (the bandits opened the back door of the Buddha's palace, and I was in the front, so I didn't hear. There were two more doors in front of the room, but they were obscured by the Dharma palace, so they didn't know). They couldn't open the main door, they tried to enter through the window, but the inside was already well installed. They were tired and the sky was about to dawn, so they had to leave.

Hearing my brothers tell it like that, I immediately thought of the eighth benefit in the 28 benefits mentioned in the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, which is completely and correctly fulfilled. Good and knowledgeable people, from now on, if you have enough sincerity and earnestness to make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, you will definitely fully achieve these 28 benefits. This is the truth and is not false.

25. The inspiration when chanting Ksitigarbha Sutra

tom_tat: The miraculous Dharma of Buddha, the power of Buddha's compassion, there is no Buddhist who does not know about it. If we talk about knowledge of Buddhism, perhaps what I know is just a grain of sand, but if we talk about belief in compassion and miracles...
noi_dung:
(According to Nhuan Mai Buddhists)

Namo Amitabha Buddha !

The miraculous Dharma of Buddha, the power of Buddha's compassion, may not be known to any Buddhist. If we talk about knowledge of Buddhism, perhaps what I know is just a grain of sand, but if we talk about belief in the compassion and miracle of Buddha's power, perhaps that is the strength of faith and a great help to help me get to where I am today. I am very grateful for this fate .

The fate in heaven and earth is very wide, and I have walked closer to the Buddha Dharma because of circumstances and fate. I believe that some things do not come by chance, but are "predestined" or "pre-arranged". Talking about "Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva" who is great and compassionate and saves suffering, perhaps everyone has heard of or worshiped him. So what about "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva". I know him also because of "Buddhist predestined Dharma" and more and more inspired things make me believe more and more, so today I want to share what little I have. know, to hopefully send something good to you .

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is the image of holding a pearl of light to illuminate the darkness, holding a golden wand to shatter the prison doors to save all sentient beings. He saves sentient beings from hell to the human and heavenly realms. But when I started reciting the "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra", it would be more accurate to say that I only thought of the deceased, or the spirits (who had taken refuge in Buddhism) and the ghosts (who had not taken refuge) around my house. When I recited that sutra, I only hoped that the surrounding spirits would hear it and be able to practice, gently and quickly escape and be reincarnated into a prosperous human life. A weak-minded person like me, at first I was scared when I read the chant, I felt like there was something hovering around me, but I believed that if I didn't do anything wrong, no one would harm me!

I read the Ksitigarbha Sutra for nearly a year, and then my grandfather passed away when he was old. I took the Bible with me to Hue. Every night I sit in front of the Avalokitesvara Buddha's table, and next to me is my Inner spirit. My grandmother's house was in a crowded city, but the house was built in the style of a Hue garden house. At that time, it was around the 11th lunar month, it was cold, so the house looked out and it was completely dark. Next to it, there was a stream and bamboo trees rustling in the wind. Late at night, all the visitors had gone home, and 2 or 3 relatives remained. There are only two grandparents in the paternal house, and they rarely make offerings, so in my opinion, the spirits here have not heard the scriptures, so they are probably very "hard-working". I was alone in the quiet space, sitting and chanting sutras... Even though I still read this sutra and am familiar with it, I don't understand why I found it extremely difficult and tiring to read there. I don't know if the weather was cold or something, but at that time I only had a feeling of healing and fear... but because of the hope of reducing the sin karma, it would be easier for Noi to be at peace because in the Ksitigarbha Sutra, it is written: "After they have died, if you can cultivate many good deeds for them for 49 days, then you can make those beings forever leave the evil path and be reborn in the realm of heaven." heaven or the human world to enjoy wonderful and wonderful peace and joy; Current relatives also receive countless benefits. "So I continued to recite it. (I heard many people say that if one does not have a relationship with the Ksitigarbha Sutra or is prevented from reading it by evil spirits/spirits, the reader will be very tired and have headaches).

My mother knew that Hue was a spiritual land, so spiritual matters should not be taken lightly. Seeing me reading at night, looking tired, she worried about me. I imagine the scene when I read the spirits around me. If the spirits like to practice, they will listen and be grateful to me, but on the contrary, they can stop me and make me tired. My mother seemed uneasy about me. Even though she didn't say it, I understood and thought for a moment that maybe when I go to the South, I should read the Pho Mon Sutra, which I usually read, and reduce the Ksitigarbha Sutra.

After leaving Hue for Vung Tau and returning home, I had every intention of stopping reading the Ksitigarbha Sutra, but suddenly that night I had a very strange dream: "Someone told me that in the land around where I was living, there was a spirit that had been liberated by listening to my sutra, so they were very grateful, and that person even reminded me to recite the "Great Compassion Mantra". Waking up from the dream, I knew what I should continue to do! (Later I found out that it was before chanting the sutra. Ksitigarbha or whatever sutra you should read the Great Compassion Mantra first )

I continued to read and chant the Tibetan Sutra, until one day suddenly a great and painful loss came to me, which was the separation of a loved one. I'm in so much pain. And everything happens like a dream, that only those involved can understand, can verify and believe. Through this incident, I believe even more in Ksitigarbha's Buddhist power of compassion and inspiration.

I was notified 3 days after that person's death. I still often have premonition dreams, but they are often vague, either a few days ago or remembered right after the event happened. But this time, especially last night's dream, it happened the next day. Every morning when I wake up, I know what will happen today, so I go step by step to accept that loss in a painful and prepared way. Whatever comes will come. After 3 days of being informed by the dream, I was in pain, tired, and cried until my eyes were blurred. At that time, I was angry and asked: "What have I done wrong, that You give me this great sadness?" I was quite exhausted and fell asleep without realizing it. After a few minutes of being tired and falling asleep, I dreamed, or rather saw, I opened my eyes clearly, a gentle feeling, not panic, looking towards the right hand side of the bedroom wall, a very clear pale pink light, (the shape of the deceased) I looked closely, not panicking, I heard that pink light say clearly each word: "If I continue to live, I can only live for 6 more years", I looked at the door and slowly woke up, I understood one thing: , if this passing happened 6 years later, would I still be able to live soberly? So that departure was because of me? Not wanting me to go to the extreme of pain, so you decided to cut this life off? Bondholder's injustice? In the sutras it is written: "If any good man or good woman can play all kinds of music, sing, or sing in front of the Bodhisattva's statue, or praise and make offerings of incense and flowers, or even advise one or more people to do the same, then such people will in the present and future lives be constantly protected by hundreds of thousands of ghosts and spirits, day and night, and evil deeds will not be allowed to reach that person's ears. Let alone having to endure those disasters..." I seemed to gently understand!

It is said that "The same voice corresponds, the same energy meets the same demand." When everything comes together, sometimes it is fate, and sometimes it is debt or karma. Being together depends on whether it is enough happiness or not. I told my nun and a friend who is good at horoscopes. Both of them said, That person has the fate to come to me but does not have enough blessings to correspond with me, has enough fate but lacks blessings. At that time I didn't think much. Blessings, big and small, are fateful encounters in life, and they are also relationships between people for each other. It was difficult for me to avoid mistakes in this life and the sins of previous lives. So I continued to do what the dream showed me, and led me to the temple, taking refuge according to the person's thoughts. Then that night I dreamed of the image of the deceased rejoicing in a rosary in the temple grounds that I sent. For a week straight, I was warned by a dream every night, then I followed it, then dreamed about the answer to what I did and what they were like. Especially every time I wondered something, it was answered to me through the dream. Perhaps I am also gradually perfecting the thoughts of the deceased. Then I began to vow to read the "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra" 7 times (7 books) and read the "Rebirth Mantra" 21 times/night (49 nights) to dedicate to the deceased. At first I planned to read it at home, but after going to the Cuu Huyen pagoda (where Ksitigarbha and his incense spirits are worshiped), I changed my mind. Because in the sutra it is said: "Within 49 days, those who have passed away need their relatives to do meritorious deeds and recite them." prayer so that they can reduce their karma." At that time, I thought that there were people who had passed away and had not yet been liberated, so I decided to sit and read at the altar of the Nine Legends, in front of which was the painting of the Three Saints and the statue of King Ksitigarbha, surrounded by the urns or pictures of the deceased sent here to pray for the spirits here and sentient beings in the ten directions to be liberated, reincarnated or reborn in the Western Pure Land (the first few days of sitting was very trembling, but with the solemn and warm atmosphere of the Nine Legends, I was less afraid and once I was determined to do so Anything for someone will have great power). So every day I went to Cuu Huyen to clean his altar, sweep it clean, make offerings and recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra. Because in the sutra it is written, "If you read 3 or 7 times, the dedicated soul will be reborn in the heavenly or human world to enjoy wonderful joy." I focused on reading. During the time I read the 7 sutras, at night I often dreamed of beautiful Buddha statues (I had rarely seen them before), and slept peacefully and gently. When I read nearly 2 variations, I dreamed of many clouds floating on the middle of a very beautiful pink frame. I found it very strange because there were not yet 3 variations, but if I think about my nearly 2 readings plus thanks to the monks in the temple joining forces to read it, it would be enough for 3 variations, could it be that... ?? I still didn't dare to believe it. Because during that time, I had a very big question: I'm afraid that the person who went like that did something wrong in his previous life, why did he have such a short life, what kind of karma did he cause?... Then that night I dreamed of a policeman, in which I went to release snakehead fish, but there was a fish that was cut into 3 and still swam in the water. Next, I saw the face in the snake. The frame looked like a strange middle-aged man's funeral, looking closely at my face, his eyes moving, as if he wanted to say something, I was so scared.. I woke up from a dream and couldn't sleep, I kept thinking and thinking but still couldn't understand. Every day I still recite sutras at the temple. Two days later, I was reading the passage in the Ksitigarbha Sutra: "If Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva meets someone who kills living beings, he said the retribution is premature death", I was startled and stopped reading over and over again and thinking about the question I have been wondering about, could it be that the past life of the person who is currently deceased? So I think, if the blessings are thin, we should do more work to help them create thicker blessings. If they can't go to heaven, then we still hope they will be reincarnated.into a happy family. I continued to recite the sutra, make offerings, release sentient beings... While reading about the 5th or 6th episode, that night I dreamed that I was reading the sutra passage, in large clear letters, on the right position of the sutra page, the words in the sutra appeared: "The Devas often follow the guardian" and then in that sentence, many red spots of light appeared like fireflies flying out from the page and approaching me, a very beautiful sight. When I woke up, I really didn't dare to believe what I was dreaming about, because I thought I wasn't lucky enough for it to be true. (The Devas are the spirits that I dedicated and have now ascended to heaven). The day I read the 7th episode, I was really anxiously waiting for tonight's dream. Because in the sutra it is written: "If someone reads enough times, the Bodhisattva will tell that person the realm in which their relatives have been born." That night I slept normally, didn't dream anything, but as usual I woke up at 5:00 a.m. The next day I woke up and fell asleep again. In my dream I saw a handsome baby boy from a wealthy, powerful family. I looked at it as strange, as close, wanted to love it but could only watch from afar because I knew it was no longer related to me, but my mood at that time was very happy because I was in a rich family that loved its children. I smiled with peace of mind, because after all, I would fall into a prosperous family, a better life than if I continued in the present, to escape this short life... I slowly woke up and it was already 6:00 a.m., I lay still for another 5 minutes to remember the dream, to reflect, my heart was calm and gentle, my heart was deeply grateful to Ksitigarbha. That morning I went to the temple to recite the 8th verse to thank Him for everything.

Before the end of the 7th incident, that night I dreamed of a man like an ancient king's soldier at the temple. Around the area where I was, first there was a spirit, then there was another spirit. When I woke up, I was very scared and confused. So I asked the monk about this and her friend, who is familiar with spiritual horoscopes, agreed to continue reading and reciting the Ksitigarbha sutra. Perhaps they want to practice, want to be liberated, but no one in their family knows how to do it, so they came to ask me...please help them receive them and recite the sutra.

Under the inspiration of the Ksitigarbha Sutra, I vowed to read 7 more times to dedicate to my ancestors, the "nine mystical ancestors" of my family, and sentient beings throughout the 10 directions (fellow compatriots, unborn lives, abandoned fetuses, incense/spirits in the land, unjust property owners...) with the thought that they would not be attached to the body that no longer belonged to them in order to purify them. Peacefully transfer to another life, the abandoned lives, please do not complain in order to be freed, the unjust bondholders, do not complain about retribution... but for some reason, the first 2 days I had a headache after finishing the recitation. I think back, maybe, like people who are still attached to worldly things when they die, it is difficult to escape. So after reciting, I made a clear vow. I sincerely dedicate the merit of reciting this in the hope of alleviating their karma. If I can become a human, I hope to have a happy human life. If my blessings are thick, I will also be able to go to heaven, so I hope the spirits will be happy to accept me. Then after that, I feel better and no longer have headaches.

Then comes the 7th variable. When reading the 7th variation of this second vow, the total of 2 vows is 15 repetitions, exactly on the 21st day from the start of going to the temple to recite the sutras, which is also the last day to complete 15 vows. And that very noon, because every noon I bowed to Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva in the open air outside the temple yard after reciting Ksitigarbha and left, but especially this time, white clouds formed beautifully behind him. Perhaps this is the first time I have been impressed by this scene, it is the fate of the Dharma and it could also be a natural coincidence. That very night, around 5:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m., I dreamed that the statue of Ksitigarbha appeared, his lips smiling lightly in a red robe. I clasped my hands to admire the beautiful, gentle and compassionate drawing... A very beautiful, gentle dream. . I silently thank the inspirations that I have been fortunate to encounter like this. I smiled gently, seeing serenity somewhere, and deeply thanked Buddha's compassionate power and the miraculous Dharma that never abandons sentient beings!

I finished writing this article on January 28, 2019, but I haven't sent it yet. I wanted to stay and see if I had a dream message, whether or not I should post it on social networks. So on the night of the 28th and the morning of the 29th, I dreamed that I was standing and praying in front of the statue of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara when suddenly a man with a good appearance, tall, gentle and kind appeared. The appearance of a monk, wearing a blue robe. I looked at the very familiar face, then looked more closely, it was the features of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Waking up from the dream, I lay awake until morning. Actually, at that time, a very strange feeling arose in me, in addition to the respect, sincerity and admiration for Bodhisattva's profound and compassionate Buddha power, it was a love that no words could express. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is so compassionate, so close to all living beings without fear of difficulty or discrimination. Just like his high and profound vow of compassion:

” All sentient beings are saved

Just got Bodhi

Hell if there is

I haven't become a Buddha yet."

Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva!

26. Super For Father

My name is Thuy Huong, dharma name Dieu Lan, I am currently 39 years old and live in Binh Thanh District, City. HCM. On the occasion of Vu Lan holiday, I would like to share with you a very interesting story about my father, also for you to understand more about how to help your loved ones escape to a peaceful realm.

When my father was alive, although he did not know much about Buddhism, he still worshiped the Buddhist altar very thoughtfully and was a gentle person. During his life, he often gave in and helped others.

His life passed peacefully until late in life, when illnesses began to come one after another. That is also the rule of old age, but from here, he encountered strange spiritual things, which were very difficult to explain.

His stroke was the disease that caused him to decline the most quickly. From a person who walked quickly and healthily when he was young, he became a person who walked slowly and often stumbled and fell. That day, my whole family closed the door to eat and buy medicine for him as usual, while he slept in his room.

About an hour after we returned, we heard him tell us that he couldn't sleep. He went to the living room to try to sit comfortably, but unexpectedly fell. But fortunately, three young men helped him back into the room. My father asked me to thank them.

My mother and I looked at each other without saying a word. Originally, my mother and I were afraid that he would be harmed by strangers or thieves, so when we went out, we carefully locked the outside door very securely. When I returned, the door was still locked, so who were the 3 young men supporting my father?

I suddenly remembered, before liberation, in front of my house, a soldier was shot dead. My father knew about it so he built an altar to worship him. The other two people were probably my brother who passed away when he was young and an anonymous child who died near the house. My dad felt sorry for him so he built an altar for him. Thinking so, I quickly went to burn incense to thank them for helping my father while we were away.

Things went by, my father became weaker and weaker, gradually he could not walk and had to lie down. At this time, he could not speak clearly.

Want my father to get better, and I already have a deep affinity for the Ksitigarbha sutra, so in addition to reciting the Ksitigarbha sutra to dedicate merit to him, I also turned on the machine to chant the Ksitigarbha sutra and Buddha recitation music for him to listen to, helping him eliminate karma & form deep good relationships in the Dharma.

A few months later, while feeding him, he suddenly told me he heard something and died.

He said:

- Last night I saw two men, one with a white face, one with a black face, come and call me.

When I heard that, my hands trembled so much that I almost spilled the bowl of porridge. Isn't this description exactly like Black White Impermanence - messenger of the Underworld? I was very afraid, because if these two people came, my father would not have much longer to live, but I still tried to stay calm and continued asking:

- So what do you say?

- Dad said: "I'm not going anywhere, I have to stay home and take care of the house"

- Do you know who those two men are? What is the shape?

- 2 men, one dressed in white, one dressed in black, the black man holding a stick like a trident, the white man holding a stick like a whisk. Where are those two men wearing such strange clothes?

- I don't know dad, they must be joking, dad

- Yes, dad said no, those two men kept forcing him to go, dad said he had to consult with both of you before he could decide.

- That's right dad, you shouldn't go, who will take care of you after you leave?

- Yes, that's why my dad told me to come in a few days.

My father's answers actually took a long time and were very difficult to hear because at this time his tongue was stiff so it was very difficult to pronounce. After hearing my father's appointment in a few days, I hugged my father and cried because I thought my father would leave me in a few days.

But after a while I still didn't see anything, I thought, perhaps one day on earth is equal to a whole year in the underworld. If my father agreed for a few days, maybe it would take a few years for those men to return.

Indeed, it was not until 4 years later, after meeting Hac Bach Vu Thuong, that my father passed away.

He passed away peacefully, without pain. That is a blessing that few people have.

Perhaps, when he was young, my father was a gentle man, and when he was old, he listened to Buddhist scriptures, so he could make an appointment with the messenger of Am Ty. From my father's story, at that time I believed that I could postpone death if I spent my whole life cultivating and accumulating virtue.

After my father passed away, I continuously recited the Ksitigarbha Sutra and did good deeds to dedicate merit to him.

If one day I am busy with work and cannot recite the sutra, then I recite the name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. After reciting and reciting, I always whisper in my mind to my father, advising him not to cling to anything else in this world, because now that he is gone, even if he wants to hold on, there will be nothing, it will only make it more difficult for him to escape.

Continuously chanting & giving advice like that until one day, I dreamed that he came to visit me. Somehow, in my dream I still knew he was dead. I immediately said angrily:

- If your father is dead, why should you come back here?

Hearing that, he was a bit sad and said:

- If you say so, I'll go.

When I woke up in the morning, I was very angry with myself for saying something that made my father sad. But I am even more saddened to know that he is still attached to his family and has not yet transcended to the higher realms.

I immediately went to the altar to burn incense and pray: "Dad, my mother and I are living very well now, please go back to life, don't cling to your family, you will suffer a lot"

After that, I continued chanting, doing what needed to be done to dedicate the merit to my father.

After a while, I dreamed of him again. This time I remained silent and didn't say anything. He looked very happy. He was wearing a blue T-shirt and light brown pants - the clothes he liked to wear when he was alive.

Dad came closer to me, smiled, patted my head and said:

- Poor daughter, it's been so hard for you, from now on you don't need to dedicate merit to me anymore, this time I'll visit you one last time to let you know that I'm going to the good world.

After that, Dad walked leisurely away, not looking back at me once more. At that time, I just looked and couldn't say a word.

When I woke up, I rushed to burn incense for my father, feeling happy because I knew he had gone somewhere very peaceful as he said. However, until now, every time I do something, I still silently dedicate it to my dad. Pray that my father will always be born in a place of peace and happiness.

In the Ksitigarbha Sutra, it is taught that, if a relative dies in the family, and the living person does good deeds and dedicates merit to the deceased, one way or another they will know where that deceased person will go. I myself have experienced many miraculous inspirations when reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra, and this story is one of them.
